formulas.getEnemyExp_formula: Starts at 6 for level 0; adds (4 + Math.floor(i / 10)) for i = 0..level-1

skills.name: Falchion Proficiency (Passive)
skills.description: Increase damage and attack rate when using falchions. Also applied to dual wield.

skills.name: Axe Proficiency (Passive)
skills.description: Increase damage and attack rate when using axes. Also applied to dual wield.

skills.name: Sword Proficiency (Passive)
skills.description: Increase damage and attack rate when using swords. Also applied to dual wield.

skills.name: Heroic Stamina (Passive)
skills.description: Allows you to carry more weight.

skills.name: Inner Strength (Passive)
skills.description: Increase HP & SP Recovery speed.

skills.name: Battle Frenzy (Passive)
skills.description: 8% chance per skill level to become berzerk during close combat.

skills.name: Enlightenment (Passive)
skills.description: +5 to all attributes per upgrade level.

skills.name: Falchion Final Blow (Passive)
skills.description: Attacking rapidly with a falchion triggers extra fierce slashes. Can combo with Falchion Flurry.

skills.name: Axe Final Blow (Passive)
skills.description: Swift axe attacks trigger a deadly axe chop. Can combo with Axe Reaper.

skills.name: Sword Final Blow (Passive)
skills.description: Quickly attacking with a sword triggers an additional powerful strike. Can combo with Sword Lunge.

skills.name: Falchion Flurry (Active)
skills.description: Rapidly slash a single enemy. Can combo with Falchion Final Blow.

skills.name: Axe Reaper (Active)
skills.description: A single powerful blow that damages all nearby enemies. Can combo with Axe Final Blow.

skills.name: Sword Lunge (Active)
skills.description: A powerful thrust that damages enemies in front of you. Can combo with Sword Final Blow.

skills.name: Hurricane I (Active)
skills.description: A spinning attack that damages all enemies in range.

skills.name: Hurricane II (Active)
skills.description: A more powerful spinning attack that damages and knocks back all enemies in range.

skills.name: Blade Storm (Active)
skills.description: Deal intense damage and knock back all enemies in range as you whirl and move through them for several seconds.

skills.name: Force Wave (Active)
skills.description: Hurl a wave of pure energy from your weapon to damage enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Elemental Wave (Active)
skills.description: Channel wild elemental magic to blast enemies in front of you with thunder, fire, ice, or poison.

skills.name: Force Globe (Active)
skills.description: Blast all enemies in range with an explosion of wild magic.

skills.name: Berserk (Active)
skills.description: Greatly increase attack power, but lose some defense.

skills.name: Sprint (Active)
skills.description: Increase your movement speed for a short time.

skills.name: Life Force (Active)
skills.description: Gain temporary HP & SP, and a chance to revive from death one time.

skills.name: Dash (Active)
skills.description: When wielding two weapons, summon a powerful force that prevents all damage and propels you forward at great speed.

skills.name: Backstab I (Active)
skills.description: Instantly move behind an enemy and attack it one time.

skills.name: Backstab II (Active)
skills.description: Instantly move behind an enemy and attack it three times.

skills.name: Backstab III (Active)
skills.description: Instantly move behind an enemy and attack it six times.

skills.name: Guardian (Active)
skills.description: Summon a elemental Guardian to protect you from harm.

skills.name: Divine Blessing (Active)
skills.description: All your attacks deal maximum damage for a short time.  Deal increased damage to enemy armor.

skills.name: Fire Elemental (Active)
skills.description: Summon a Fire Elemental to hover around you and damage all enemies in range.

skills.name: Deflection (Active)
skills.description: When actively defending with a shield, enemy damage to HP is absorbed by your SP instead.  If you actively defend just before the enemy attack hits, you recover some HP and SP, and can deal damage to enemy armor.

skills.name: Shield Bash I (Active)
skills.description: Strike enemies with your shield, crushing their armor and knocking them back.

skills.name: Shield Bash II (Active)
skills.description: Strike enemies heavily two times with your shield, crushing their armor and knocking them back.

skills.name: Set Skill
skills.description: You must equip an entire set of linked items to control their hidden power.

skills.name: Summon Storm (Active)
skills.description: Summon a storm elemental.  It obeys your commands, attacking all the enemies in its path.  Use the mouse to control its movement.

skills.name: Meteor Storm (Active)
skills.description: Call upon ancient forces to rain meteors upon enemies in target area.  Those who attempt to escape judgement will be severely punished.

skills.name: Charge Slash I (Passive)
skills.description: Hold down the attack key to gather strength for a fierce attack.  Once the charge halo appears, release the attack button to perform a powerful attack that deals heavy damage to an enemy's health and armor.

skills.name: Charge Slash II (Passive)
skills.description: Hold down the attack key longer to gather even greater strength for a deadly attack.  Once the charge halo appears, release the attack button to perform an extremely powerful attack that deals heavy damage to an enemy's health and armor.

skills.name: Assassin (Passive)
skills.description: Deal amplified damage to enemies when attacking them from behind.

skills.name: Last Stand (Passive)
skills.description: There is a chance that lethal damage will reduce your HP to 1 instead of killing you.

skills.name: Tiger Jump (Passive)
skills.description: Avoid all damage when starting a jump.

skills.name: Protection from Evil (Passive)
skills.description: Enhanced resistance to cursing magic.

skills.name: Dual Wield (Passive)
skills.description: Wield two weapons with ease.  Gain great attack speed, but lose some attack power and defensive capability.  Higher skill levels amplify damage.

skills.name: Cross Slash (Passive)
skills.description: When wielding two falchions, you can strike with both blades at the same time, dealing enhanced damage.

skills.name: Master of Defense(Passive)
skills.description: While equipped with a shield, you can recover HP from each successful active defense.

skills.name: Damage Reflection (Passive)
skills.description: There is a chance that some of the damage dealt to you is also dealt to the attacker.

equipmentSets.name: Many ambitious warriors have searched the world for the fabled Blazing Set.  Once united, the fire-enchanted helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and weapon give the user an affinity for fire, and the ability to summon flames to burn enemies.  The wearer of the Blazing Set deals more damage in combat, and has an increased chance to score critical hits. (Extra attrib.: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 fire attribute, Lv3 attack bonus. Set skill: Fissure I)

The Swamp Witch's failed golem experiments gave rise to items which seem strangely alive.  Those who wear the envenomed helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and weapon can summon a Plague to weaken their enemies.  The wearer can also dissolve worthless materials left behind by fallen foes to reveal magical treasures more often, recover from injuries more rapidly, and has affinity for poison.
Set C

A secret society of vampires constructed life-draining armor for their battle thralls.  Those who wear the vampires' helmet, armor, gloves, and boots find that they heal quickly, and absorb life energies from slain foes. (Extra attrib: Lv4 HP recovery, Lv4 HP gained after an enemy was killed)

Legends tell of an ancient underground kingdom powered by mysterious magic crystals.  Explorers have discovered crystal-embedded artifacts created by this forgotten culture.  Those who wear the crystal helmet, armor, gloves, and boots will discover that they possess inexhaustible magic power. (Extra attribt:  Lv4 SP bonus, Lv4 SP recovery)

Frost Dragons cast magical traps on portions of their treasure hoards to catch thieves.  An enterprising alchemist discovered that he could transform these magical traps into useful items.  A human who wears the frost-enchanted helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and weapon gains an affinity for cold and the ability to attack foes with ice magic.  Skilled warriors can use the elemental power of ice to deal critical hits against enemies and deal greater damage in combat. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 ice attribute, Lv3 additional attack. Set skill:Cracking Ice I)

Thor himself is said to have created arms and armor to help mortals defend themselves against giants.  A worthy hero wielding one of Thor's weapons and wearing the lightning-enchanted helmet, armor, gloves, and boots can shoot lightning bolts at enemies.  Those who possess the Lightning Set are likely to score critical hits in combat and attack with greater ferocity and speed. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 thunder attribute, Lv3 additional attack. Set skill: Chain Lightning I)

Zealous warriors of the northern tribes once threw themselves into battle, howling with bloodlust as they slew invading armies.  One by one, these ferocious warriors fell, but their spirits melded with their weapons and armor.  Anyone who wields a Zealot's twin weapons while wearing their helmet, armor, gloves, and boots will find that they are able to endure deep wounds, deal great damage in combat, and blast their enemies with magic. (Extra attrib: Lv4 additional attack, Lv4 additional HP. Set skill: Fissure II)

It is said that divine beings gave humans powerful weapons and armor to defend against evil.  When united, these gifts could call down lightning to repel Titans.  Many of the heroes in the ancient tales possessed these powerful weapons.  To wield a Hero's weapon while wearing their helmet, armor, gloves, and boots is to come in contact with that mysterious ancient force.  The wearer will deal greater damage in combat and take less damage from enemies.  They will also gain greater magic power and toughness. (Extra attrib: Lv4 additional attack, Lv4 additional defense, Lv3 additional HP, Lv3 additional SP. Set skill: Chain Lightning II)

A group of wizards and witches formed an organization known as The Guardians to protect people from the evil sorcerer Mordeki and his army of cruel Death Knights.  They crafted magic helmets, armor, gloves, boots, and shields reinforced with defensive spells that protected them from both physical and magical attack. (Extra attrib: Lv4 additional defense, Lv4 magic resist)

Spider Clan Assassins were feared for their stealth, silence, and deadliness.  Their most elite agents earned a set of dual weapons, a helmet, armor, gloves, and boots that enabled them to easily score critical hits and poison enemies in combat.  The wearer also gained greater health and magic power, and the ability to cast poison spells at foes. (Extra attrib: Lv4 critical hit, Lv4 poison attribute, Lv2 additional HP, Lv2 additional SP. Set skill: Poison II)

The Lord of Shadow once ruled the surface world.  Few dared to speak his name.  To those who served him, he granted twin weapons and a special set of armor.  Anyone wearing the Shadow Lord's helmet, armor, gloves, and boots while wielding his dual weapons surged with great health and magic power, could command ice magic, and deal heavy critical hit damage in combat. (Extra attrib: Lv4 critical hit, Lv4 additional attack, Lv3 additional HP, Lv4 additional SP. Set skill: Cracking Ice II)

It was recently discovered that the legendary dwarven explorer known as "Lucky Rob" owed his good fortune to an unusual set of items.  Anyone wearing Lucky Rob's helmet, armor, gloves, and boots while wielding his weapon will discover that they have an uncanny instinct for finding treasure.  Interestingly, the items seem to sense when the wearer is in danger and can guide a combatant to strike at an enemy's weak spot. (Extra attrib: Lv4 critical hit, Lv3 critical hit, Lv4 drop rate)

Kang was a famous sword master who dazzled his opponents with his speed, skill, and explosive power.  The Master's twin weapons, helmet, armor, gloves, and boots are exceptionally light-weight and strong.  A skilled fighter wearing the Master's gear can deal greater damage in combat, score critical hits more often, and gains the ability to cast fire magic that splits into three additional fireballs on impact. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 additional attack. Set skill: Split Fire I)

The Southern Warlords discovered that certain combinations of looted artifacts could be bound together to grant them greater power.  Their sages performed rituals to bind a fire elemental into their Lord's weaponry.  Such a weapon linked to a magical helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and shield grant their user greater attack strength, increased health and magic power, and an affinity for fire magic.  Wearers of this set can cast a fireball that strikes up to six additional targets. (Extra attrib: Lv4 fire attribute, Lv4 additional attack, Lv3 additional HP, Lv3 additional SP. Set skill: Split Fire II)

A group of villagers assembled their ancestral artifacts to supply the hero Linok with armor as he prepared to battle the demon Gomon.  They were amazed to see that once united, the separate treasures pulsed with power.  The helmet, armor, gloves, and boots increase their wearer's attack strength and critical hit chance in combat.  The user also gains more health and magic power, and has a greater chance to find items of value. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv2 additional attack, Lv2 additional HP, Lv2 additional SP, Lv2 additional drop rate)

quests.title: Equip items
quests.summary: Get a weapon, shield, and cap from Gran, then talk to Wayne.
quests.dialogAccept: It seems that Arkenveil holds many secrets.  I am sorry to burden you with bad news after your great victory, but a new calamity has befallen our village...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Apparently, our ancestors chose this site to imprison Ssyba, The Devil of the Abyss who oppressed our world a century ago.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The dungeon entrance leads down to the chamber where Ssyba is sealed.  Worse, there are signs that the evil Lord Zark has already entered.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Lord Zark is obsessed with the idea of freeing Ssyba in exchange for eternal life.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Are you prepared to deal with this threat?
quests.dialogConfirm: Excellent!  Gran will equip you.  Once you are properly attired, return to me.  There is much to discuss…
quests.dialogReject: If nobody opposes Lord Zark, Ssyba will be freed…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Please talk to Gran.  He is an able blacksmith, and will provide you with the tools you need to face the challenges ahead.
quests.dialogComplete: You are a fine hero indeed, but you cannot hope to save the world alone![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] It is vital that you consult with the other villagers.  Anyone who urgently requires your assistance will show signs to alert you.  Speak with all the villagers and learn how we can help each other overcome our troubles.  Time to begin your quest!

quests.title: Spider Hunt
quests.summary: Pass through the portal Susan opened into the Dark Forest.  Kill 3 spiders, then talk to Paul.
quests.dialogAccept: As a captain in the King's Elite Guard, one of my duties is to build alliances.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Susan has opened a portal to the Dark Forest.  The kindly forest folk who live there remain unseen by human eyes, but are preyed upon by large spiders.  If you could go kill 3 spiders and report back to me, it would significantly improve relations between our two cultures.
quests.dialogConfirm: Gran will supply you with equipment.  You need weapons and armor if you want to help out around here.
quests.dialogReject: Scared?  That is a serious problem for a hero…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Enter the portal, kill three spiders, then report back to me.
quests.dialogComplete: Well done!  Here is something for your trouble…

quests.title: Spider Slayer
quests.summary: Kill 7 spiders in the Dark Forest.  Gain a level, assign ability and skill points, then talk to Paul.
quests.dialogAccept: Hunting spiders in the Dark Forest does much to improve our relations with the Fair Folk.  Kill 7 more spiders, but take the time to demonstrate your prowess to anyone who might be watching.  Attain a higher level, and push your abilities and skills to the limit.  Once you have done all this, return to me and we shall talk.
quests.dialogConfirm: I need not remind you of the importance of proper provisions in battle.  Susan will supply you with the potions you need to stay healthy in combat.
quests.dialogReject: Scared of spiders?
quests.dialogIncomplete: Kill 7 spiders in the Dark Forest.  Gain a level, assign ability and skill points, then we'll talk!
quests.dialogComplete: Well done.  A hero must be willing to act on faith, and take risks to help those he may never meet.  You have earned this reward!

quests.title: Frosty Combination
quests.summary: Enchant your weapon with Ice damage.
quests.dialogAccept: Through the art of combination, we bring together elements to produce powerful results.  Combination can greatly enhance you equipment!
quests.dialogConfirm: Take these 2 Small Wind Crystals and a Stone of Blessing.  Combine them with your weapon to enchant it with Ice damage.
quests.dialogReject: Don't be afraid to study and practice!
quests.dialogIncomplete: Please combine 2 Small Wind Crystals and a Stone of Blessing with your weapon.
quests.dialogComplete: You have talent!  Any time you want to combine something, come see me.  Use the "?" on the combination panel to review details.

quests.title: Candy for Crystal
quests.summary: Help Anna trade Chung a piece of candy for a crystal.
quests.dialogAccept: Can you help Anna?  Anna is learning combination from Susan.  Yesterday I made a mistake and wasted a crystal.  I don't want to ask Susan, because...  Can you help me get one from Chung?  He likes to trade!  Here is the last piece of candy my mom left me...  Will you trade Chung this candy for a small wind crystal?  Can you do that for me?
quests.dialogConfirm: Thanks, big brother!  Here's the candy!
quests.dialogReject: I'm too shy to ask…  He might say no…
quests.dialogIncomplete: I hope Chung can say yes to you!
quests.dialogComplete: Wow!  I get the crystal and the candy!  I will study hard, and make something useful for you, too, some day!

quests.title: Antivenom
quests.summary: Collect 12 samples of spider venom from the Dark Forest.  Deliver them to Susan.
quests.dialogAccept: The toxic gas rising from the dungeon is making people ill...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Inhaling too much of the poisoned air could kill you!  You cannot enter the dungeon.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Susan has been working on a way to immunize us from the effects of the foul miasma...  Can you help her?
quests.dialogConfirm: Great!  She mentioned needing 12 samples of spider venom to complete the potion.  Please, go talk to Susan and give her what she needs.
quests.dialogReject: Sickness and death…  Who can save us?
quests.dialogIncomplete: Did you get 12 bottles of spider venom?
quests.dialogComplete: You brought the venom?  Excellent!  I can make enough Antivenom for the whole village, and nobody need fear the poison gasses again!  I'll let you know when it's done…

quests.title: Team Up
quests.summary: Find Kimura and invite him to join your quest.
quests.dialogAccept: Kimura has expressed an interest in joining you on your missions.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] He has been training hard.  His skill and determination gives Kimura the potential to become a great hero.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Will you please invite him to join you in your quest?
quests.dialogConfirm: I expect great things of both of you!
quests.dialogReject: You can let me know your decision later…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Why not talk to Kimura?  It can't hurt to have an ally in the dungeon.
quests.dialogComplete: It is wonderful to see young people working together![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Susan has prepared the Antivenom.  We should all go see her now.

quests.title: Petrified Elf
quests.summary: Ask Susan to help cure a petrified elf.
quests.dialogAccept: A petrified elf woman in the dungeon?  If she is one of the great heroes of old, restoring her could save us all![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Ask Susan if she can help cure the elf!
quests.dialogConfirm: Go quickly!  Susan can cure that elf, I'm sure of it!
quests.dialogReject: You are the only one who can accurately describe her condition…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Consult with Susan.  Tell her what you know, and she can figure out a way to cure that elf!
quests.dialogComplete: The elf you saved is the legendary Celest!  Our chances of surviving the dangers ahead have dramatically improved.  Thank you![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] We must have faith that heroes will rise to stem the tide of darkness…

quests.title: The Book of Omen
quests.summary: Search the dungeon for The Book of Omen.
quests.dialogAccept: It has come to my attention that The Book of Omen can be found in the dungeon![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The Book of Omen contains much wisdom.  It is written by the heroes of old.  It might teach us how to defeat Ssyba!  It lies somewhere in the dungeon below...  Will you retrieve it for me?
quests.dialogConfirm: Search carefully!  We must have that book!
quests.dialogReject: Please reconsider.  The information in that book could save us!
quests.dialogIncomplete: Any luck finding The Book of Omen?
quests.dialogComplete: Amazing!  With the Book of Omen in our possession, much will be revealed!  Please accept this token of our gratitude.

quests.title: Minotaur Onim
quests.summary: Defeat Guardian Onim on the 7th floor of the dungeon.
quests.dialogAccept: I must tell you of a great danger that lies ahead!  Anyone who descends deep into the dungeon will encounter the Three Guardians.  The first Guardian is Minotaur Onim, a master of fire and thunder magic.  He awaits you on 7th floor.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The second Guardian is a Beholder that watches over the 17th floor.  Cerberus, the final Guardian, dwells on the 27th floor.  Furthermore, your path is barred by magic seals...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Fortunately, I can conjure the elemental Yooseki stones you will need break the seals.  I already possess the Fire Yooseki.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Are you ready to take it, and face Onim?
quests.dialogConfirm: Carry the Fire Yooseki to the seal on the 7th floor, and challenge Onim!
quests.dialogReject: Return to me when you are ready to face this challenge…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Prepare well.  Onim is a dangerous opponent.

quests.title: The Beholder
quests.summary: Defeat the Beholder on the 17th floor.
quests.dialogAccept: The second Guardian is even more dangerous.  The Beholder who lurks on the 17th floor is famous for tormenting heroes with his thunder and poison magic.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] You may be forced to fight him to the death.  Are you prepared to do so?
quests.dialogConfirm: Here is the Water Yooseki you will need to open the seal on the 17th floor.  Take care!
quests.dialogReject: Perhaps when you are stronger…
quests.dialogIncomplete: The Beholder is a cunning enemy.  Good luck!

quests.title: Cliff Crossing
quests.summary: Deliver 20 lizardman tails to Geb.
quests.dialogAccept: What cliff?  Oh, yeah.  That chasm is easily crossed, if you're willing to pay![*DONT DELETE THIS!*]I need 20 lizardman tails, but they won't sell them to me.  My buyer is getting angry.  You will have to kill them to get the tails, but that's business!  Anyway, they hunt humans...  Give me the tails, and I'll give you a crossing!  Do you accept?
quests.dialogConfirm: Deal!  Now go get those 20 lizardman tails for me!
quests.dialogReject: You'll be back…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Where are my lizardman tails?  I need 20 of them!  Take the path behind me and start chopping!
quests.dialogComplete: 20 lizardman tails!  I'll be rich!  Ahem…  I mean, maybe someone will pay a little for these…  Ok, let's see about getting you across that chasm…

quests.title: Captain's Ring
quests.summary: Find an old captain's ring for Paul.  The ring is carved with the initials "R.R."
quests.dialogAccept: According to The Book of Omen, one of my predecessors rescued a dwarven king during a battle in the dungeon, but lost his arm in the process.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] It is my duty to see that the old captain of the guard's signet ring is returned to his family.  His ring bore the initials "R.R."  Will you keep an eye out for it during your exploration of the dungeon?  Will you help me honor the memory of our heroic forefathers?
quests.dialogConfirm: I hope you are able to find it…
quests.dialogReject: If you don't have the time…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Did you find the ring?  The Book mentions that it is a magic ring, so maybe an evil mage has taken it?
quests.dialogComplete: You found the ring?  I hope it was not too much trouble.  Large or small, acts of honor will be remembered.  Please, have this!

quests.title: Knight's Badge
quests.summary: Show the Knight's Badge to the cursed Knight and return it to Paul.
quests.dialogAccept: You met a cursed knight?  He spoke to you!?  He must have had a great sense of duty in life...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] My Knight's Badge is a holy symbol that represents my honor, and my word.  Showing it to him might help him break free of the curse.  Do you want to try using my Badge?
quests.dialogConfirm: Command this Knight to accept honorable discharge, and get some rest.  Report back to me once your mission is complete.
quests.dialogReject: All right, you can try something else first…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Did you try showing the Knight my Badge?
quests.dialogComplete: We have freed one of the great heroes of our past.  May he rest in peace…

quests.title: The Cerberus
quests.summary: Defeat the Guardian Cerberus on the 27th floor.
quests.dialogAccept: On the 27th floor, you will find Cerberus, the final Guardian.  Do not underestimate his power.  His ice and poison magic has felled many a demon.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The other Guardians were nothing compared to him.  To survive a fight with Cerberus, you must be in peak condition, and carry plenty of potions![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Are you ready to face this awesome foe?
quests.dialogConfirm: Take the Field Yooseki.  I admire your courage.  Good luck.
quests.dialogReject: We do not know another way…
quests.dialogIncomplete: I have faith that you will emerge victorious!
quests.dialogComplete: You amaze me.  Let us hope your most difficult battles are behind you...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] What?  The Cerberus was kind to warn us, but if Zark has already made it so far, how can we hope to stop him in time?  What will become of the world…

quests.title: Another Key
quests.summary: Find another key for the altar gate.
quests.dialogAccept: I'm so glad you've returned safely.  Any word on Paul?  He's dead?!  No!  What about Anna??  Still haven't found her… [*DONT DELETE THIS!*]  It is an endless nightmare...  now is Anna missing...  Paul dead... [*DONT DELETE THIS!*] What? You need two keys to open the altar gate?  Hmm...  can you show me the one you took from the Cerberus?
quests.dialogConfirm: There is something familiar about this key...  Please, may I examine it more closely?[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I know!  My amulet looks just like it!  My father told me to give it to the one who would deliver us from evil.  Could this be the second key?[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Take it!  There may still be time to prevent Ssyba's revival and save Anna!
quests.dialogReject: If you show me the key, I might be able to help…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Does the key work?  Is the gate open?  I can't stop thinking about Paul and Anna…  Paul's wounds were so deep, but he insisted on trying to save Anna…  I see now that the knight's way is to protect the innocent, even if it means death…

quests.title: The Final Battle
quests.summary: Bring death to the enemy!
quests.dialogAccept: You have opened the altar gate?  Excellent!  Know this:  the final altar atop the Burning Temple is a portal that leads directly to the chamber where Ssyba is sealed, but you cannot pass through safely without my spells to protect you.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*]Shall we go to the final portal now?
quests.dialogConfirm: Let's go!
quests.dialogReject: The portal was fashioned so that nobody could pass through without death magic shrouding their life force…  Let me cast the spell to send you to the final floor.
quests.dialogIncomplete: Have you passed through the altar?  Did you find Zark?  I can keep the way open, and channel my energies to keep you alive, but the rest is up to you.  I know you can do it!

quests.title: Hammer of Doom
quests.summary: Find the "Doom Hammer" created by Gran's ancestors.
quests.dialogAccept: Long ago, my grandfather crafted many of the best weapons and armor used by the heroes of legend.  It is said that he forged these great works with a powerful hammer, called Doom.  It was his most prized possession.  Items crafted by Doom's power gained mysterious attributes...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Tragically, Grandfather lost his favorite hammer during an expedition into the dungeon.  I'm not sure why, but he never tried to recover it...  Maybe he just thought the war was ending, and there was no need for Doom's power anymore...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] War has returned.  With the Doom Hammer, I might be able to create more powerful items--maybe I can forge the greatest weapon of all!  If you find the Doom Hammer, can you bring it back to me?
quests.dialogConfirm: Thank you, my friend!  Please return Doom to me as soon as you find it!
quests.dialogReject: Oh…  I understand…  too busy saving the world to look for an old hammer…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Have you found the Doom Hammer?
quests.dialogComplete: Incredible!  You found it!  Strange that such power could have come from something that appears so ordinary...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*]  Ha!  I think I understand...  "Doom" is not the name of the hammer, it is my grandfather's legendary title!  Grandfather Doom Hammer![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] That he once held this hammer...  I feel that he is near me.  I must work harder!  I will uphold the honor of our family name![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Thank you for finding the hammer for me, my friends! Take this!

quests.title: Bat's wings
quests.summary: Collect 10 pairs of bat wings for Geb.
quests.dialogAccept: What?  You ask me if I've seen a hammer called Doom?  An old blacksmith's hammer, right?  It's right here in my backpack!  It took such a long time to acquire this particular item...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Give it to you?  No way!  I am a merchant!  I bargain, I trade...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Seems you really want it...  how about we make a deal?  I'll give you a discount.  How does a million gold sound??[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Wow!  I can see that humans are quite sensitive about gold, but I like a challenge...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I'll trade you this hammer for 10 pairs of bat wings!  Bring me the wings, and you can have this "wonderful" hammer...
quests.dialogConfirm: Deal!  Go now, my bat hunters!  Bring me my wings!
quests.dialogReject: I'm still waiting…  Where are my wings?  Get back to work!
quests.dialogIncomplete: I guess you must not really want that hammer.
quests.dialogComplete: You work quickly!  Now, about Doom's hammer…  Here you go!  All yours!

quests.title: Trap Training
quests.summary: Scour the dungeon traps for treasure left behind by unfortunate heroes.
quests.dialogAccept: In case you didn't already know, this dungeon is full of traps.  Arrows fire from the walls, flames burst from the floor, and generally horrible things happen if you aren't careful. [*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The fiends baited the first set of traps to lure people in, which means you are going to learn about traps and get paid at the same time![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] So here is what you do:  go tinker around with the first set of traps, figure out how they work and how to avoid getting killed, snatch the good stuff from them, and I'll throw in a little extra as a reward.  What do you say?
quests.dialogConfirm: That's the spirit!  Test each trap and try to understand how it works, and you won't get seriously hurt…
quests.dialogReject: Forget it if you're scared…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Get through all the traps, collect the treasure, then come see me!
quests.dialogComplete: Smooth moves, man!  You passed the traps and got the treasure?  Nice!  Here, take this, too.

quests.title: Love and Roses
quests.summary: Find the Rose Necklace and bring it to Chung.
quests.dialogAccept: Listen…  I have a secret.  Please, don't laugh.  There's this girl, Mary...  She loves roses, and I want to give her a special gift.  I've been searching for the Rose Necklace to give to her, as a token of my love.  If you find it, I'll pay you handsomely for it.  Deal?
quests.dialogConfirm: Thank you, my friend!  You understand love!
quests.dialogReject: You won't help?  Oh, my dear Mary…  Only the Rose Necklace can express my true feelings for you…
quests.dialogIncomplete: Have you found the Rose Necklace?  If I had it, I know I'd have to confidence to tell her how I feel…
quests.dialogComplete: You found it!!!  It's perfect!  I can't wait to see Mary's eyes light up when I give it to her!  If she accepts my love, I'll give you a lifetime discount on all future purchases!  See how love changes a man?

quests.title: Grandfather's Armor
quests.summary: Help Gran retrieve his ancestor's armor.
quests.dialogAccept: My skills are improving, but I could really use some examples of Grandfather's greatest works.  Grandad gave all his creations away and focused on making tools and toys after the war...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Somewhere in the dungeon, there has to be an example of his best work left behind...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Can you do me a favor?  If you find any armor marked "T.C Craft", could you bring it back to me?  T.C. was what all his guild buddies called Grandad.
quests.dialogConfirm: I really appreciate it.  Once I get my hands on one of Grandfather's famous suits of armor, I know I can build upon his work.
quests.dialogReject: A pity.  You are the only one who can help me find that armor.
quests.dialogIncomplete: If you find any armor marked "T.C." you'll bring it to me, yes?
quests.dialogComplete: Gramp's armor!  This is great!  Let me see it...  The mix of materials, the shape, the precise crafting…  Awesome work!! [*DONT DELETE THIS!*] It would have been decades before I could have matched this craftsmanship, but now I have a chance to duplicate Grandfather's work!  I'm sure I can create even more powerful items soon![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Thank you so much!  Here, please take this.

quests.title: Money Saving
quests.summary: Save up 10,000 gold and show it to Chung.
quests.dialogAccept: If you can save money, you can buy great things.  Saving a huge pile of gold can be fun!  Save up 10,000 gold, come to me, and I will give you a super cool treasure![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Do we have a deal?
quests.dialogConfirm: Great!  Better start saving!
quests.dialogReject: What?  You don't trust me?
quests.dialogIncomplete: Keep working at it, and you'll save up 10,000 gold in no time!
quests.dialogComplete: Nice to see that young people know how to save their money!  Are you ready for your super cool treasure?  Here you go!

quests.title: Anna's Presents
quests.summary: Distribute Anna's gifts.
quests.dialogAccept: Hee hee...  Anna has a secret![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] After mom and dad died, the villagers became all my moms and dads.  Even when I am very bad, they are still nice to me...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The reason I asked you to get things earlier was so I could make gifts for everyone!  I did all the combining myself!  It will be a big surprise!  Will you help me give people their gifts?  Anna is too shy to do it alone…
quests.dialogConfirm: Great!
quests.dialogReject: Too busy?  Help Anna later?
quests.dialogIncomplete: Have fun giving gifts!
quests.dialogComplete: Everyone is so happy!

quests.title: Elf Poem
quests.summary: Discover the combination formula hidden in the elvish poem:  "On a day without wind, she lays in the field, her flowing song is a blessing."
quests.dialogAccept: The Book of Omen reveals much about the art of combination. [*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I am convinced that the elvish poem on this page is also a formula.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The poem reads:  "On a day without wind, she lays in the field, her flowing song is a blessing."[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Will you help me make sense of it?
quests.dialogConfirm: Thanks.  This poem is a real puzzle…
quests.dialogReject: It seems that nobody understands…
quests.dialogIncomplete: "On a day without wind, she lays in the field, her flowing song is a blessing..."  I wonder how this relates to combination?
quests.dialogComplete: You figured out the meaning of the poem?  How clever you are!

quests.title: Cure Anna
quests.summary: Deliver 20 centaur's horns to Susan so she can cure Anna's illness.
quests.dialogAccept: Anna has fallen ill, under a foul curse cast by the Beholder.  If Anna grows any weaker, she may die!  I can cure her, but I need 20 centaur horns for the medicine.  Can you get them for me?
quests.dialogConfirm: Bless you.  Bring me 20 centaur horns as quick as you can.  The curse is draining her life force.  Anna could die at any moment!
quests.dialogReject: Please reconsider…  Anna's life is at stake!
quests.dialogIncomplete: Did you get 20 centaur horns yet?  You must help me free her from the curse, or there is little hope Anna will survive…
quests.dialogComplete: I'll start brewing the potion immediately.  Anna will be well, and protected from future curses of this type!  Take this small reward for your kindness.

quests.title: Dungeon Exploring
quests.summary: Explore the dungeon, become an 8th level hero, and return to Paul.
quests.dialogAccept: You see that dungeon entrance near the old well?  Rumor has it that skilled heroes have already begun searching it.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I need someone to explore the dungeon and report back their findings.  If you meet any 8th level heroes, bring them back and we'll try to recruit them![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Will you take this mission?
quests.dialogConfirm: Fantastic!  Take care in the dungeon.  Retreat if it looks too dangerous!
quests.dialogReject: We'll talk when you're ready.  If you see anyone who looks  strong enough for the job, send them my way!
quests.dialogIncomplete: Any news of the dungeon?  Did you find an 8th level hero?
quests.dialogComplete: What?  The dungeon sounds quite dangerous…  Oh!  You are the level 8 hero?!  Yes, I see that you are!  Here, take this!

quests.title: Find Paul
quests.summary: Search for Paul in the dungeon.
quests.dialogAccept: Paul is in great danger!  He has gone after Anna, who is surely being taken to the deepest floor of the dungeon.  I fear that she will become the instrument of Ssyba's return...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I will protect the village!  Go after Paul and save Anna!
quests.dialogConfirm: Please hurry!
quests.dialogReject: I understand, if you must prepare…

xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示1: Strike the instant the Charge Slash halo appears to multiply your damage.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示2: When actively defending against enemy attacks with a shield, magic power absorbs most damage.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示3: Actively defend just before an enemy attack hits.  Knock back some enemies, and regain significant health and magic.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示4: Elite monsters whose names appear in yellow have high armor.  Using heavy attacks can break armor and stun the enemy.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示5: Some skills and heavy charged attacks are very useful for breaking enemy armor.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示6: The 4th slash of the dual-falchion technique can chain into devastating finishing moves and deal huge damage to a single enemy.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示7: When wielding two weapons, you lose some attack power and defensive capability, but gain tremendous attack speed.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示8: Shield bash attacks deal low damage, but are more likely to break enemy armor.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示9: Deal 20 times the damage the instant the attacking halo appears, but the long charge up time can leave you vulnerable to quicker enemy attacks.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示10: The Assassin skill amplifies damage whenever you attack an enemy from behind.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示11: Backstab can be used to attack airborne enemies.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示12: Timed active defense can prevent all damage, even from poison.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示13: Kimura is extremely agile.  Traps don't affect him at all.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示14: When Kimura pretends to be dead, he slowly recovers HP.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示15: The Tiger Jump skill makes you invulnerable when you start to jump or bounce on an enemy's head.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示16: Dead monsters, broken jars, and smashed wooden barrels reappear every 20 minutes.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示17: A small area with one entrance...  Rare treasures and strange monsters can sometimes be found within.
xmlDataSystem_1.加载提示19: A yellow Armor Bar appears below a heavily armored monster's health.  Armored enemies take less damage from all attacks.  Once you break an enemy's armor, finish them off quickly before they can repair their broken armor.

xmlDataDialog.村长对白1-1: Welcome back, young hero![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Despite your triumph over the two-headed giant, we remain in peril.  We've been forced to barricade the front gate.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Beware the foul gasses rising from the dungeon entrance.  The tainted air saps a man's strength to the point of death.
xmlDataDialog.村长对白1-2: Susan has opened a gateway.  It leads to the Dark Forest.
xmlDataDialog.铁匠对白1-1: Nice to see you!  I've been working with new metals, and slowly deciphering my grandfather's smithing journal.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] So far the results are excellent, but I have much to learn…
xmlDataDialog.铁匠对白1-2: My grandfather once crafted arms for the warriors who fought Ssyba!  Now that the dungeon is open again, and it's my turn to supply heroes like you with the tools to get the job done![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I wonder if I can ever match the great works my father and grandfather built...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Maybe if I had grandfather's Doom Hammer, I could forge legendary weapons, too?
xmlDataDialog.铁匠对白1-3: Please, take a weapon, a shield, and a cap for free!  I wish I could give you more.  Bring back materials and gold and I will build you even better gear!
xmlDataDialog.巫女对白1-1: My potions will help sustain you through many hardships.  Bring me gold and ingredients, and I will supply you with what you need.
xmlDataDialog.巫女对白1-2: Before you can enter the dungeon, you must drink a special mild Antitoxin, or the poison miasma will kill you.  Bring me spider venom from the Dark Forest, and I will brew the potion you need.
xmlDataDialog.巫女对白1-3: You remember how to use the potions?  When you acquire a potion, it appears in your inventory.  Double click a potion to use it, or place them in a quick slot and press 1/2/3/4 to use them.  Red potions heal injuries, and blue potions replenish magical energy.  Purple potions instantly heal your wounds and give you magic power.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Recently Anna is learning the art of Combination.  The child has talent![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Combination can greatly enhance weapons and other equipment.  Encourage Anna in her studies, and you will unlock great powers.
xmlDataDialog.商人对白1-1: Hey there, young man!  Long time, no see!  Thanks for providing me with so many of the two-headed giant's treasures![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Things are even more dangerous underground than above!  Don't worry!  I'll sell you what you need at a good price, friend![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I wonder what amazing things you'll find in the dungeon...
xmlDataDialog.商人对白1-2: A small Wind Crystal?  I've got what you need!  Very expensive...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Whaaat?!  Anna wants to trade me a piece of candy for it?  The child has no sense of how much things cost![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Fine!  Just take it, for Anna's sake.  I'll charge you a little extra on future trades to recover my loss...
xmlDataDialog.骑士对白1-2: I suspect that Lord Zark is responsible for opening the dungeon gate.
xmlDataDialog.骑士对白1-3: My generation was trained to fight soldiers, not monsters and magic…  If only we had embraced the old ways, the two-headed giant would not have taken over so easily…
xmlDataDialog.骑士对白1-4: I know little about the dungeon.  I do know that death awaits the unwary.
xmlDataDialog.女孩对白1-1: Yay!  Big brother![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] You helped Anna so much!  Anna wants to help you![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Susan teaches me about Combination.  Anna thinks combination is very interesting!
xmlDataDialog.女孩对白1-2: Listen!  Small Potion + Small Potion = Medium Potion;  Medium Potion + Medium Potion = Big Potion;  Red Potion + Blue Potion = Purple Potion...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Anna is memorizing combination rules!  Does big brother remember?  Anna's Teddy Bear can also do it!
xmlDataDialog.村长对白2-1: Anyone who drinks Antitoxin can safely enter the dungeon gate near the center of town.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Be sure to breathe back in any belches you have after descending.  It will further immunize you from the poison miasma.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*]If you grow tired, come back.  Rest here in safety and reequip before continuing deeper.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Time grows short...  God speed, and good luck!
xmlDataDialog.骑士对白2-1: I've not yet ventured into the Devil's Prison, but I've fought my way through many a dark dungeon and cave.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Go in prepared to fight.  Be sure to carry plenty of healing potions and town portal scrolls if you want to come out alive.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The elders tell tales of Elves, Dwarves, and Humans banding together to fight Ssyba.  They cast aside prejudice and became a mighty force.  I hope I live to see an Age of Heroes come again.
xmlDataDialog.商人对白2-1: Have you begun your exploration of the dungeon?  No matter how great the treasure is, it can't be worth the risk!  Gold means nothing to the dead.
xmlDataDialog.商人对白2-2: We are lucky to have a true hero in our midst!  Show me what you find down in the dungeon.  I will pay well for things you may think are worthless.
xmlDataDialog.商人对白2-3: What?!  You think my offer too low?  Only a fool would try to cheat a slayer such as you.  Trader San in the next village pays but a tenth of what I offer!
xmlDataDialog.女孩对白2-1: Small Potion + Small Potion = Medium Potion; Medium Potion + Medium Potion = Big Potion; Red Potion + Blue Potion = Purple Potion...
xmlDataDialog.女孩对白2-2: Hi!  See, Anna remembers recipes!  Does big brother remember?  You should learn, too.  So easy!
xmlDataDialog.村长对白3-1: After speaking with Celest, I am convinced that she is a true hero.  Just being near her eases my worries.
xmlDataDialog.骑士对白3-1: In ancient times, human savagery drove the elves to distant lands.  That an elf should fight to protect us gives me hope that our cultures will be reunited…
xmlDataDialog.巫女对白3-1: The anti-petrification potion worked?  That is wonderful news!  It was an elf?  I look forward to speaking with her!
xmlDataDialog.铁匠对白3-1: Elvish armor is magnificent!  I'd love to meet the smith who made it.
xmlDataDialog.商人对白3-1: Rescued an elf, eh?  What was your fee?  The elves are renowned for their riches!
xmlDataDialog.精灵对白3-1: Thank you for freeing me from the stone.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Wayne has recounted what has transpired during my absence, but there is still much that I must learn.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I am eager to finish the fight we started so long ago... once I regain my strength.  Though I am not yet ready to do battle, I will heal any who require my aid.  I shall remain here in the village, should you have need of me.

xmlDataDialog1.地精商人1: Ah!  A human hero and a…  Ranger?
xmlDataDialog1.地精商人2: Haven't seen a human in ages.  Is the gate open again?  Anyway, welcome customers!  Monster or human, I have something for everyone!
xmlDataDialog1.地精商人3: What are you looking for?  See anything you like?
xmlDataDialog1.木村对白1-1: Could I be the greatest archer of all time?
xmlDataDialog1.巫女特殊1: Petrified Elf?  I have a potion to cure petrification.  If you use it to help others, maybe someone will return the favor one day.
xmlDataDialog1.巫女特殊2: Try using the potion on the elf.  I hope it works…
xmlDataDialog1.巫女特殊3: What can I do for you?  Potions (J) or Combination (K)?  Quit (ESC)
xmlDataDialog1.商人特殊1: You want something?  Better bring gold!  Enter my shop (J) or quit (K)?
xmlDataDialog1.骑士特殊1: Pack too full?  Overloaded?  Store it here.  Enter (J)!
xmlDataDialog1.铁匠特殊1: Hey there!  You need equipment?  Enter my shop (J) or quit (K).
xmlDataDialog1.村长特殊1: I've taken over Paul's job guarding your loot.  Enter (J)
xmlDataDialog1.地精特殊1: Peruse my wares!  Satisfaction guaranteed!  Enter my shop (J) or quit (K).
xmlDataDialog1.介绍1: Ssyba, the imprisoned Devil of the Abyss, has promised Lord Zark immortality in exchange for freedom.  Now the world hurtles toward Armageddon, to satisfy one man's lust for power…
xmlDataDialog1.介绍2: A young adventurer, fresh from his last victory, has come to save the day!  Whatever the cost, whatever the challenge, this brave champion never gives up.
xmlDataDialog1.介绍3: Darkness engulfs our world, but a Hero gives us hope that a new day shall dawn…
xmlDataDialog1.照看宝箱: I can take care of your chest when Paul is not here.

xmlDataDialog2.村长对白5-1: The Beholder slain!  Ho, ho, heroes!  May Lord Zark soon feel the bite of your blades!
xmlDataDialog2.村长对白5-2: We have learned much from the Book of Omen.  Susan's impassioned translation has roused a fighting spirit among the people.  To hear the tale of the ancient Alliance, one has hope that we can beat the devil!
xmlDataDialog2.村长对白5-3: Celest draws power from our ancient stones to cast a magic shield over the village.  No monster will cross it, and the barrier blocks out the evil miasma.
xmlDataDialog2.骑士对白5-1: I was surprised to learn that the Book of Omen contains the journal of a Knight's Captain.  I've learned a lot by studying his exploits.
xmlDataDialog2.骑士对白5-2: Celest's magic has cured me of all injury.  In a few days, I will be ready to fight once more!
xmlDataDialog2.骑士对白5-3: In The Book, it is written that many a hero was twisted by dark magic to become a servant of the devil…  As it was with the Two-Headed Giant and the zombies he made of my knights, we shall have to cut down once proud men to finally bring peace to their tortured souls…
xmlDataDialog2.精灵对白5-1: Though you have defeated The Beholder, I fear that even more deadly beasts await you.  Please take care, and return safely.
xmlDataDialog2.精灵对白5-2: Your strength and courage uphold the legacy of the heroes of old.  It is good to see that the old ways have not died.
xmlDataDialog2.精灵对白5-3: I have cast a magic shield to protect this village from evil, but I cannot sustain it forever.  Even now, the shield weakens...  Find Zark soon, and put an end to his evil ways.
xmlDataDialog2.巫女对白5-1: Every country has stories of the great evil caused by villains obsessed with immortality.  Anyone can achieve immortality through their children and their good works.  Living forever, unchanging...  that goes against the nature of Life.
xmlDataDialog2.巫女对白5-2: Thanks to you, Anna will live.  She smiled soon after drinking the potion.  Also, I feel that Celest's shield has done much to soothe all our suffering.
xmlDataDialog2.铁匠对白5-1: I'm happy to help in any way I can.
xmlDataDialog2.铁匠对白5-2: My own lack of confidence was holding me back.  I know I can do better.  I know it!
xmlDataDialog2.铁匠对白5-3: Thanks for returning Grandfather's armor!  Now that I have studied it, I have learned some of his secrets.  My future works will be of superior quality, for sure!
xmlDataDialog2.商人对白5-1: Is there another merchant undercutting me out there?   Why are my goods not selling as well?
xmlDataDialog2.商人对白5-2: Mary said yes!  My sweet beloved!  This darkness cannot last forever in a world with such love.
xmlDataDialog2.商人对白5-3: Ah, there is nothing worth more than love!  What's wrong with me!!!  I'm going to lose my merchant's license!
xmlDataDialog2.女孩对白5-1: Thanks for saving me! Anna feels better now!
xmlDataDialog2.女孩对白5-2: Susan told me there is a horrible devil living underground!  Anna is scared!  Are you going to go spank that nasty devil?  Anna wishes she was brave like you!
xmlDataDialog2.女孩对白5-3: Teddy Bear wants to be big and strong like you, too!
xmlDataDialog2.村长对白6-1: Are Ann and Paul ok?  I'm so worried about them!
xmlDataDialog2.村长对白6-2: The Cerberus is dead, but no sign of Zark?  Where can he be?
xmlDataDialog2.精灵对白6-1: I hope the little girl and the knight are safe…  Go help them if you can.  I will defend the village.
xmlDataDialog2.精灵对白6-2: The magic shield cannot last much longer.  Once it breaks, I do not know that I could raise it again…  The situation grows dire…
xmlDataDialog2.巫女对白6-1: Let us pray for Anna and Paul's safe return…
xmlDataDialog2.巫女对白6-2: Anna's gifts combine magnificently!  The child is a genius!  She is a worthy apprentice.  I hope I have the chance to pass all my knowledge on to her some day.
xmlDataDialog2.铁匠对白6-1: Paul will bring Anna back, for sure!  I hope my armor and weapons are protecting him well…
xmlDataDialog2.铁匠对白6-2: Take heart, my battle worn friend!  I promise I will continue providing you with the finest gear until my dying day.
xmlDataDialog2.商人对白6-1: You haven't found Zark yet?  Are we in trouble?
xmlDataDialog2.商人对白6-2: I hope Anna and Paul come back soon!
xmlDataDialog2.村长对白7-1: Paul gone…  little Anna in peril…  the world slowly slipping into chaos…
xmlDataDialog2.村长对白7-2: As his chamberlain, I saw Zark grow from an uncertain lad into a fine man.  I'll never understand what turned him toward evil.
xmlDataDialog2.村长对白7-3: You will soon arrive at the deepest level of the dungeon.  The hour of victory is at hand!
xmlDataDialog2.精灵对白7-1: Paul shall be remembered as a true knight.  He always fought for justice, with courage and grace.
xmlDataDialog2.精灵对白7-2: You have done well, but do not become overconfident.  Ssyba is far more powerful than the Cerberus.  It would be best to stop Zark before he can revive the devil…
xmlDataDialog2.精灵对白7-3: The spell used to revive Ssyba is lengthy and complex.  There may still be time to prevent Zark from completing the ritual.
xmlDataDialog2.巫女对白7-1: I am sorry to hear that Paul has passed from this world.  May he rest in peace…
xmlDataDialog2.巫女对白7-2: You have been drinking too many potions.  I realize that the enemies are growing stronger, but you must take care of your health.  Potion addiction felled many heroes.
xmlDataDialog2.铁匠对白7-1: Brave Paul…  fought to the end.
xmlDataDialog2.铁匠对白7-2: You go down into the dungeon again and again…  Why risk your life in such a dangerous place.  Maybe we should pack up and leave…
xmlDataDialog2.铁匠对白7-3: Don't worry.  I respect you, and know a true hero when I see one.  I will support you to the end, no matter what happens.
xmlDataDialog2.商人对白7-1: Paul is dead?  Is no one safe?
xmlDataDialog2.商人对白7-2: Are we all doomed to die at the hands of monsters?
xmlDataDialog2.商人对白7-3: I appreciate the business…  but if there is no hope of winning, shouldn't we get out of here?  What?!  Well, if the world might end if we lose, I might as well try to help…
xmlDataDialog2.村长对白8-1: You have saved Arkenveil!  Your name will live in the hearts and songs of the people, forever!
xmlDataDialog2.精灵对白8-1: You defeated Ssyba!  I'm so proud!
xmlDataDialog2.巫女对白8-1: You are the heroes of your generation.  Pass on what you have learned.
xmlDataDialog2.铁匠对白8-1: You inspire me to do great work.
xmlDataDialog2.商人对白8-1: Everything back to normal?  Good for business!
xmlDataDialog2.女孩对白8-1: Thanks for saving Anna.  Anna has a chance to grow up now.

xmlDataDialog3.村长对白4-1: I cannot believe Lord Zark would revive Ssyba!  The entire mainland will be enslaved!  Zark has surely embraced the ways of the devil!  It is my duty to protect the people.  But how…
xmlDataDialog3.村长对白4-2: If Ssyba returned…  it would be the end of everything…  We must stop Lord Zark!  We need your help!
xmlDataDialog3.村长对白4-3: Celest was there when Ssyba slew 100 heroes and bathed in their blood…  Under Ssyba's rule, there was great suffering.  The light of hope was almost extinguished.  It was only through a last, desperate, unified assault that Ssyba fell...  now he may rise again...
xmlDataDialog3.村长对白4-4: Celest gives us hope.  She has a subtle healing magic that raises all our spirits.  She has also told us much about the enemy.
xmlDataDialog3.骑士对白4-1: It is an amazing thing to meet a hero out of the old tales!  I wonder how long an Elf can live…
xmlDataDialog3.骑士对白4-2: For a man, immortality is just a dream.  Zark's crime is unforgivable.  I am charged with bringing him before the King to face final judgement.
xmlDataDialog3.骑士对白4-3: Courage is an essential quality for any knight, but as you get older, you realize that knowing when to retreat is just as important.  If the going gets tough, fall back, build up your strength, and try a different approach.
xmlDataDialog3.巫女对白4-1: The Book of Omen tells of The Great War.  Wayne asked for my help in translating it.  The old dialects, and portions written in the non-human languages are proving most difficult, but it is a worthwhile challenge.
xmlDataDialog3.巫女对白4-2: My husband has not returned from his journey, but I have faith that he still lives…  He is a fighter, a survivor.  I know he will come back to me, but I miss him so…
xmlDataDialog3.铁匠对白4-1: As you battle monsters, I battle steel!  I must make better equipment!  If only I had better tools…  I must try harder…
xmlDataDialog3.铁匠对白4-2: The monsters grow stronger...  You won't last long using only what I can build.  You should combine materials to imbue your equipment with greater power.  Susan is skilled in Combination.
xmlDataDialog3.铁匠对白4-3: As I wield Grandfather's hammer , I feel that he is by my side, guiding my hand with his wisdom.
xmlDataDialog3.商人对白4-1: Ah, Mary…  Sweet, wonderful Mary…  A beautiful name…  Who's Mary?  She's mine!  No more questions!
xmlDataDialog3.商人对白4-2: Love...  No treasure compares to it.  What?  You want to know the sequence of the 3 aspects?  Difficult question, yes…
xmlDataDialog3.女孩对白4-1: I might be memorizing too much...  my head hurts…
xmlDataDialog3.女孩对白4-2: I want to work hard to help people, just like you!  Anna hopes she can help you beat the bad guys some day!
xmlDataDialog3.精灵对白4-1: The villagers have been helping me recover.  Their good food and good cheer are most welcome.
xmlDataDialog3.精灵对白4-2: It seems like I was battling the Dark Forces only yesterday…
xmlDataDialog3.精灵对白4-3: I was saddened to learn that a human has been seduced by Ssyba's lies, and seeks to revive the devil.
xmlDataDialog3.精灵对白4-4: Zark must be stopped.  If Ssyba rises again, the green land will burn black, the skies will once again be choked by toxic clouds…  the living shall be enslaved, and they will envy the dead…  We must end this madness!

xmlDataItems2.hel1i: Low cost, practical head gear used by most fighters.
xmlDataItems2.hel2i: ranger's head guard.  Light-weight, useful when fending off weaker monsters.
xmlDataItems2.hel3i: Solid Orcish steel, good for protecting one's skull from most ordinary weapons.
xmlDataItems2.hel4i: Worn by Valkyries, a symbol of bravery.
xmlDataItems2.hel5i: A sturdy helmet, commonly used by knights.
xmlDataItems2.hel6i: An elegent helmet infused with elven magic.
xmlDataItems2.hel7i: Worn by one of the legendary warriors, a symbol of enduring courage and loyalty.
xmlDataItems2.hel8i: Made of dense metal that shimmers with golden light, only the strongest can wear it.
xmlDataItems2.hel9i: Crafted from blue dragon scales.  Light and supple, it possesses mysterious properties.
xmlDataItems2.hel10i: Made from red dragon scales.  Thick, heat resistant, and imbued with dragon blood.
xmlDataItems2.hel11i: Created by the ranger Carlos Castilan.  It is said to burn the flesh of anyone driven by evil thoughts.
xmlDataItems2.hel12i: Once worn by the evil knight Derek Moore, all who look upon it are filled with dread.
xmlDataItems2.hel13i: An Archangel's battle helm with the power to destroy evil runes.  Dark magic cannot damage it.
xmlDataItems2.hel14i: Ancient Chinese hero Xiakes' favorite, you feel like a great swordsman when wearing it.
xmlDataItems2.hel17i: Commonly worn by wizards during dangerous experiments, has the power to decrease damage from explosions.
xmlDataItems2.hel18i: An old wizard designed this to increase the potency of his magic by channeling energy around him to a point above his head.
xmlDataItems2.hel19i: No one knows where it came from, or what its function is.  It is very old, and radiates an aura of power.
xmlDataItems2.hel20i: The wearer can peer into the thoughts of others and instantly know the truth.  An undisciplined mind can become overwhelmed, and driven to madness.
xmlDataItems2.hel21i: It is written that the mask is the remains of a man who made a pact with the Shadow Lord.  The wearer gains eternal life and great power, but is ruled by illusion and becomes a servant of evil.
xmlDataItems2.hel22i: A jack o' latern!  Wear it!  Eat it!
xmlDataItems2.s1i: Made for novice sword fighters.  Has a good balance of damage and attack speed.
xmlDataItems2.s2i: A wicked blade of cold steel, durable and razor sharp.
xmlDataItems2.s3i: An expertly crafted sword and a symbol of nobility.
xmlDataItems2.s4i: It is said that this gift from Apollo grants its user heroic powers.
xmlDataItems2.s5i: A cursed sword that inflicts cruel wounds, but causes its owner to feel the suffering of those slain by it.
xmlDataItems2.s6i: A sinister sword that drinks the blood of its victims.  Only those who are capable of controlling powerful magic can wield it without being drained themselves.
xmlDataItems2.s7i: A fearsome blade forged for the heroes of legend, capable of splitting stone without losing its edge.
xmlDataItems2.s8i: A family heirloom, passed down through generations of heroes.  Though it is quite old, it has not lost its edge.
xmlDataItems2.s9i: Forged in the depths of the Abyss, it swirls with chaotic forces that rend flesh.
xmlDataItems2.s10i: The dwarven thief who stole it from the Great Red Dragon was burned to cinders as he unsheathed it.
xmlDataItems2.s11i: Left behind by divine beings, it hums with power.
xmlDataItems2.s12i: This blade glows with a pale, unearthly light.  Only the pure of heart may wield it.  It can banish evil spirits.
xmlDataItems2.s13i: Archangels arm themselves with these glowing swords to hunt devils.  Only true champions of justice can carry these rare and beautiful blades.
xmlDataItems2.s14i: Chinese emperor's sword.  The owner feels the confidence to rule a nation, and the courage to face all enemies.
xmlDataItems2.b1i: rangers and assassins prefer this light, curved blade over heavier swords.  It deals less damage, but allows for quicker attack speed.
xmlDataItems2.b2i: Crafted by desert nomads, this falchion has a faster attack speed and deals greater damage.
xmlDataItems2.b3i: A pirate's weapon of choice.  A deadly close combat weapon strong enough to cut through armor.
xmlDataItems2.b4i: An exotic blade, with hooks and spring-loaded switches used to perform deadly tricks in skilled hands.
xmlDataItems2.b5i: Rumored to be the work of Poseidon.  Though its magic fades while away from his watery domain, all who respect the sea find that the blade brings them strength in times of need.
xmlDataItems2.b6i: Countless nature spirits were destroyed by this blade during the War of the Gods.  Doombringer's power grew, and it threatened to cut through the fabric of existence.  A kindly druid stole the weapon and devoted himself to bringing balance to its magic, thus averting the end of the world.
xmlDataItems2.b7i: When an archmage senses that their powers are fading, they create special Runeblades.  Each rune they carve into the blade contains a portion of their magic.  Those who know the secret symbols can summon great power in combat.
xmlDataItems2.b8i: Yuri was a ranger and a skilled blacksmith who fought in the Demon Wars.  Yuri ordered his men to attack the demons, but they stabbed him in the back and fled.  That night, Yuri's falchion animated his corpse and killed all the traitors.
xmlDataItems2.b9i: This blade gains power as it drinks blood.  A chief became possessed by its bloodlust, and used its power to conquer all the surrounding tribes.  Thinking himself invincible, he was lured into an ambush and killed by goblin archers.
xmlDataItems2.b10i: Made from a wyvern's fangs, this curved blade is extremely hard, and oozes a corrosive toxin that can burn through metal.  Requires a glass-lined sheath.
xmlDataItems2.b11i: This blade contains the trapped souls of an evil wizard who sacrificed his family and his own flesh in an unholy ritual to become an undead lich.  It is said that the Soul Reaver falchion imprisons the life energies of any slain foe, preventing any chance of resurrection.
xmlDataItems2.b12i: This blade cuts through multiple planes of existence to slay divine beings.  It is believed to be a creation of the most ancient immortals, a gift for humans to liberate themselves from divine control…  when they are ready.
xmlDataItems2.b13i: A shimmering falchion that emits blinding flashes of light to banish evil spirits.

xmlDataItems2_1.a1i: Used by warriors who battle large, armored enemies.  Its heavy weight reduces its attack speed.
xmlDataItems2_1.a2i: A solid steel axe that can only be lifted by powerful warriors.
xmlDataItems2_1.a3i: Mountain Orcs carry this type of axe.  The strongest can split an armored man in half with a single chop.
xmlDataItems2_1.a4i: Chakka the Barbarian kept this axe with him at all times, and drew strength from its magic.
xmlDataItems2_1.a5i: Only the most powerful warriors can use this axe.  In the right hands, it can chop through all defenses.
xmlDataItems2_1.a6i: Can hack through shields, gates, or stone walls without breaking.
xmlDataItems2_1.a7i: The spirits deliver this weapon to those who constantly fight for the good of all and lead the way through danger.
xmlDataItems2_1.a8i: This executioner's axe claimed the lives of many who opposed Chief Hojo, until one day, Hojo himself was beheaded by it.
xmlDataItems2_1.a9i: An agent of Chaos once used this weapon to attack the link between the divine and the mortal realm.  A sacred bird snatched it from its tentacles, then plunged into the Abyss.  The bird merged with the weapon to dull its edge.
xmlDataItems2_1.a10i: Hama crafted this Axe from the remains of an abyssal devil, but tempered it with Light.  Whenever a devil of the abyss rises, the axe grows in power.  It can cut through a devil's magical defenses.
xmlDataItems2_1.a11i: Created by the great Black Dragon Vermithrax from his own tooth, this weapon grants its user great strength and protection from magical attack.
xmlDataItems2_1.a12i: A team of dragon hunters created this axe after many years of studying their prey.  They combined materials, magic, and designs optimized to harm dragons.  Unfortunately, the manual required to properly use the axe has been lost.
xmlDataItems2_1.a13i: The dwarf who stole the fabled Ice Dragon Jewel asked his comrade to make it into an axe.  He discovered that it made a fine weapon during a surprise attack by orcs who coveted the jewel.  The Ice Wedge can freeze enemies it strikes.
xmlDataItems2_1.w1i: Commonly worn by adventurers.  Not great protection in a fight, but it keeps you warm.
xmlDataItems2_1.w2i: Light weight, affordable defense for people who get into fights while exploring the wilderness.
xmlDataItems2_1.w3i: Great balanced protective gear.  A favorite of adventurers who must run and fight.
xmlDataItems2_1.w4i: Forged by Valkyries.  Provides protection for the entire body.
xmlDataItems2_1.w5i: Overlapping plates of hard steel provide excellent defense from most weapons.
xmlDataItems2_1.w6i: Built by elven spellcrafters, this armor is exceedingly light, strong, and cannot be easily pierced.
xmlDataItems2_1.w7i: This armor is a symbol of fellowship among the great heroes who fought in the Great War.
xmlDataItems2_1.w8i: Armor covered in intricate magic symbols that dance with golden light.
xmlDataItems2_1.w9i: Made from elder blue dragon scales.  Has the ability to direct the flow of magical energies.
xmlDataItems2_1.w10i: This armor was stitched together from large red dragon scales, and does not burn easily.
xmlDataItems2_1.w11i: Sir Carl's favorite armor.  The metal is infused with silver and inscribed with sigils to ward off evil.  It is said that evil spirits burn if they touch this armor.
xmlDataItems2_1.w12i: Wisps of dark magic rise from this armor to protect the wearer and terrify opponents.
xmlDataItems2_1.w13i: The armor of angels.  It repels black magic and provides excellent protection for those who do battle against devils.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield1i: A hard wooden board.  Useful for protecting beginning heroes from critical hits.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield2i: Made of hard steel, useful for blocking enemy attacks.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield3i: A thick shield, built for stronger warriors.  Provides very high defense.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield4i: A stout shield built for trained knights.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield5i: A large shield that cannot be broken by ordinary weapons.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield6i: A superior quality enchanted shield, used by the heroes of old.  Prized by collectors.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield7i: This shield was designed to be used by centaurs.  Ordinary humans have difficulty using it properly.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield8i: A beautiful, reflective, golden shield.  Though it appears to be made of gold, it is many times harder than steel.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield9i: Discarded by divine beings during a battle on the material plane.  Though damaged, it has powers beyond mortal understanding.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield10i: The metal used to create this shield arrived from another world in the burning heart of a meteor.  It is said that it can withstand dragon breath.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield11i: A focused and serene mind can sense evil spirits through the aura of this shield.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield12i: Made from the crushed, burned, and petrified heart of a black dragon, it increases its owner's strength and resistance to most types of damage.
xmlDataItems2_1.shield13i: The Archangels carry these shield into battle.  Its aura can dispel evil magic.  No evil spirit can damage it.

xmlDataItems2_2.potion10des: +30% max HP & SP.  Chance to revive if defeated.
xmlDataItems2_2.potion11des: +70% max HP & SP.  Chance to revive if defeated.
xmlDataItems2_2.potion12des: +100% max HP & SP.  Chance to revive if defeated.
xmlDataItems2_2.potion14des: Increase defense for a short time.
xmlDataItems2_2.potion15des: Improve attack strength for a short time.
xmlDataItems2_2.potion16des: Gain protection from magic damage for a short time.
xmlDataItems2_2.potion17des: Go berzerk in combat for a short time.
xmlDataItems2_2.potion18des: Improve luck, critical hit chance, and drop rate for a short time.
