xmlDataItems.套装a: Many ambitious warriors have searched the world for the fabled Blazing Set.  Once united, the fire-enchanted helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and weapon give the user an affinity for fire, and the ability to summon flames to burn enemies.  The wearer of the Blazing Set deals more damage in combat, and has an increased chance to score critical hits. (Extra attrib.: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 fire attribute, Lv3 attack bonus. Set skill: Fissure I)
xmlDataItems.套装b: The Swamp Witch's failed golem experiments gave rise to items which seem strangely alive.  Those who wear the envenomed helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and weapon can summon a Plague to weaken their enemies.  The wearer can also dissolve worthless materials left behind by fallen foes to reveal magical treasures more often, recover from injuries more rapidly, and has affinity for poison.
xmlDataItems.套装: Once every century, the Fair Folk create a suit of armor to protect honored defenders of the forest.  The Living Set consists of a helmet, armor, gloves, and boots that grant the wearer great vitality and quick recovery from any wounds.  It is rumored that those who possess this armor are immune to the effects of aging. (Extra attrib:  Lv4 HP bonus, Lv4 HP recovery)
xmlDataItems.套装d: A secret society of vampires constructed life-draining armor for their battle thralls.  Those who wear the vampires' helmet, armor, gloves, and boots find that they heal quickly, and absorb life energies from slain foes. (Extra attrib: Lv4 HP recovery, Lv4 HP gained after an enemy was killed)
xmlDataItems.套装e: Legends tell of an ancient underground kingdom powered by mysterious magic crystals.  Explorers have discovered crystal-embedded artifacts created by this forgotten culture.  Those who wear the crystal helmet, armor, gloves, and boots will discover that they possess inexhaustible magic power. (Extra attribt:  Lv4 SP bonus, Lv4 SP recovery)
xmlDataItems.套装f: Frost Dragons cast magical traps on portions of their treasure hoards to catch thieves.  An enterprising alchemist discovered that he could transform these magical traps into useful items.  A human who wears the frost-enchanted helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and weapon gains an affinity for cold and the ability to attack foes with ice magic.  Skilled warriors can use the elemental power of ice to deal critical hits against enemies and deal greater damage in combat. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 ice attribute, Lv3 additional attack. Set skill:Cracking Ice I)
xmlDataItems.套装g: Thor himself is said to have created arms and armor to help mortals defend themselves against giants.  A worthy hero wielding one of Thor's weapons and wearing the lightning-enchanted helmet, armor, gloves, and boots can shoot lightning bolts at enemies.  Those who possess the Lightning Set are likely to score critical hits in combat and attack with greater ferocity and speed. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 thunder attribute, Lv3 additional attack. Set skill: Chain Lightning I)
xmlDataItems.套装h: Zealous warriors of the northern tribes once threw themselves into battle, howling with bloodlust as they slew invading armies.  One by one, these ferocious warriors fell, but their spirits melded with their weapons and armor.  Anyone who wields a Zealot's twin weapons while wearing their helmet, armor, gloves, and boots will find that they are able to endure deep wounds, deal great damage in combat, and blast their enemies with magic. (Extra attrib: Lv4 additional attack, Lv4 additional HP. Set skill: Fissure II)
xmlDataItems.套装i: It is said that divine beings gave humans powerful weapons and armor to defend against evil.  When united, these gifts could call down lightning to repel Titans.  Many of the heroes in the ancient tales possessed these powerful weapons.  To wield a Hero's weapon while wearing their helmet, armor, gloves, and boots is to come in contact with that mysterious ancient force.  The wearer will deal greater damage in combat and take less damage from enemies.  They will also gain greater magic power and toughness. (Extra attrib: Lv4 additional attack, Lv4 additional defense, Lv3 additional HP, Lv3 additional SP. Set skill: Chain Lightning II)
xmlDataItems.套装j: A group of wizards and witches formed an organization known as The Guardians to protect people from the evil sorcerer Mordeki and his army of cruel Death Knights.  They crafted magic helmets, armor, gloves, boots, and shields reinforced with defensive spells that protected them from both physical and magical attack. (Extra attrib: Lv4 additional defense, Lv4 magic resist)
xmlDataItems.套装k: Spider Clan Assassins were feared for their stealth, silence, and deadliness.  Their most elite agents earned a set of dual weapons, a helmet, armor, gloves, and boots that enabled them to easily score critical hits and poison enemies in combat.  The wearer also gained greater health and magic power, and the ability to cast poison spells at foes. (Extra attrib: Lv4 critical hit, Lv4 poison attribute, Lv2 additional HP, Lv2 additional SP. Set skill: Poison II)
xmlDataItems.套装l: The Lord of Shadow once ruled the surface world.  Few dared to speak his name.  To those who served him, he granted twin weapons and a special set of armor.  Anyone wearing the Shadow Lord's helmet, armor, gloves, and boots while wielding his dual weapons surged with great health and magic power, could command ice magic, and deal heavy critical hit damage in combat. (Extra attrib: Lv4 critical hit, Lv4 additional attack, Lv3 additional HP, Lv4 additional SP. Set skill: Cracking Ice II)
xmlDataItems.套装m: It was recently discovered that the legendary dwarven explorer known as "Lucky Rob" owed his good fortune to an unusual set of items.  Anyone wearing Lucky Rob's helmet, armor, gloves, and boots while wielding his weapon will discover that they have an uncanny instinct for finding treasure.  Interestingly, the items seem to sense when the wearer is in danger and can guide a combatant to strike at an enemy's weak spot. (Extra attrib: Lv4 critical hit, Lv3 critical hit, Lv4 drop rate)
xmlDataItems.套装n: Kang was a famous sword master who dazzled his opponents with his speed, skill, and explosive power.  The Master's twin weapons, helmet, armor, gloves, and boots are exceptionally light-weight and strong.  A skilled fighter wearing the Master's gear can deal greater damage in combat, score critical hits more often, and gains the ability to cast fire magic that splits into three additional fireballs on impact. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 additional attack. Set skill: Split Fire I)
xmlDataItems.套装o: The Southern Warlords discovered that certain combinations of looted artifacts could be bound together to grant them greater power.  Their sages performed rituals to bind a fire elemental into their Lord's weaponry.  Such a weapon linked to a magical helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and shield grant their user greater attack strength, increased health and magic power, and an affinity for fire magic.  Wearers of this set can cast a fireball that strikes up to six additional targets. (Extra attrib: Lv4 fire attribute, Lv4 additional attack, Lv3 additional HP, Lv3 additional SP. Set skill: Split Fire II)
xmlDataItems.套装p: A group of villagers assembled their ancestral artifacts to supply the hero Linok with armor as he prepared to battle the demon Gomon.  They were amazed to see that once united, the separate treasures pulsed with power.  The helmet, armor, gloves, and boots increase their wearer's attack strength and critical hit chance in combat.  The user also gains more health and magic power, and has a greater chance to find items of value. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv2 additional attack, Lv2 additional HP, Lv2 additional SP, Lv2 additional drop rate)
xmlDataItems.加载提示1: Strike the instant the Charge Slash halo appears to multiply your damage.
xmlDataItems.加载提示2: When actively defending against enemy attacks with a shield, magic power absorbs most damage.
xmlDataItems.加载提示3: Actively defend just before an enemy attack hits.  Knock back some enemies, and regain significant health and magic.
xmlDataItems.加载提示4: Elite monsters whose names appear in yellow have high armor.  Using heavy attacks can break armor and stun the enemy.
xmlDataItems.加载提示5: Some skills and heavy charged attacks are very useful for breaking enemy armor.
xmlDataItems.加载提示6: The 4th slash of the dual-falchion technique can chain into devastating finishing moves and deal huge damage to a single enemy.
xmlDataItems.加载提示7: When wielding two weapons, you lose some attack power and defensive capability, but gain tremendous attack speed.
xmlDataItems.加载提示8: Shield bash attacks deal low damage, but are more likely to break enemy armor.
xmlDataItems.加载提示9: Deal 20 times the damage the instant the attacking halo appears, but the long charge up time can leave you vulnerable to quicker enemy attacks.
xmlDataItems.加载提示10: The Assassin skill amplifies damage whenever you attack an enemy from behind.
xmlDataItems.加载提示11: Backstab can be used to attack airborne enemies.
xmlDataItems.加载提示12: Timed active defense can prevent all damage, even from poison.
xmlDataItems.加载提示13: Kimura is extremely agile.  Traps don't affect him at all.
xmlDataItems.加载提示14: When Kimura pretends to be dead, he slowly recovers HP.
xmlDataItems.加载提示15: The Tiger Jump skill makes you invulnerable when you start to jump or bounce on an enemy's head.
xmlDataItems.加载提示16: Dead monsters, broken jars, and smashed wooden barrels reappear every 20 minutes.
xmlDataItems.加载提示17: A small area with one entrance...  Rare treasures and strange monsters can sometimes be found within.

xmlDataItems_1.加载提示19: A yellow Armor Bar appears below a heavily armored monster's health.  Armored enemies take less damage from all attacks.  Once you break an enemy's armor, finish them off quickly before they can repair their broken armor.
xmlDataItems_1.试炼之门说明: A mysterious miniature gate that radiates a sense of danger.  Double click to use.
xmlDataItems_1.隐藏地图说明: A place where equipment sets and treasure may be found.  Double click to use.
xmlDataItems_1.手记1: "The sounds of battle echo through the Undercity.  It cannot be my men…  Who approaches?"  (Double click to enter the event.)
xmlDataItems_1.手记2: "…our slain comrades have been cursed!  Those who were once dear friends have become the walking dead, controlled by foul necromancy!  My dear friends, I will not abandon you to this fate…"  (Double click to enter the event.)
xmlDataItems_1.手记3: "...I have never known a nobler soul, or a braver knight, but I fear our adventure has come to an end.  Goldbeck, the two-headed giant, approaches..."  (Double click to enter the event.)
xmlDataItems_1.试炼石板说明: Upon the stone is an inscription:  "The Stone and I open the Way."
xmlDataItems_1.半人马之角1: A centaur's horn.  Used to cure Anna.
xmlDataItems_1.石化药水1: Cure someone who has been turned to stone.
xmlDataItems_1.古书1: A century-old chronicle of the Great War.
xmlDataItems_1.火曜石1: This stone totem pulses with heat.  It is used to break a magic seal in the dungeon.
xmlDataItems_1.土曜石1: A dense stone totem.  It is used to break a magic seal in the dungeon.
xmlDataItems_1.水曜石1: A freezing cold stone totem.  It is used to break a magic seal in the dungeon.
xmlDataItems_1.牛头人欧尼姆的信1: A letter dropped by Minotaur Onim, written by Zark.
xmlDataItems_1.爷爷的盔甲1: Very old, but exquisitely well-crafted armor.
xmlDataItems_1.骑士徽章1: Used to prove a knight's identity.
xmlDataItems_1.祭坛钥匙1: Key used to open the Altar.

xmlDataQuest1.任务简要1: Get a weapon, shield, and cap from Gran, then talk to Wayne.
xmlDataQuest1.任务对白1: It seems that Arkenveil holds many secrets.  I am sorry to burden you with bad news after your great victory, but a new calamity has befallen our village...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Apparently, our ancestors chose this site to imprison Ssyba, The Devil of the Abyss who oppressed our world a century ago.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The dungeon entrance leads down to the chamber where Ssyba is sealed.  Worse, there are signs that the evil Lord Zark has already entered.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Lord Zark is obsessed with the idea of freeing Ssyba in exchange for eternal life.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Are you prepared to deal with this threat?
xmlDataQuest1.任务确认1: Excellent!  Gran will equip you.  Once you are properly attired, return to me.  There is much to discuss…
xmlDataQuest1.任务拒绝1: If nobody opposes Lord Zark, Ssyba will be freed…
xmlDataQuest1.任务未完成1: Please talk to Gran.  He is an able blacksmith, and will provide you with the tools you need to face the challenges ahead.
xmlDataQuest1.任务完成1: You are a fine hero indeed, but you cannot hope to save the world alone![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] It is vital that you consult with the other villagers.  Anyone who urgently requires your assistance will show signs to alert you.  Speak with all the villagers and learn how we can help each other overcome our troubles.  Time to begin your quest!
xmlDataQuest1.任务简要2: Pass through the portal Susan opened into the Dark Forest.  Kill 3 spiders, then talk to Paul.
xmlDataQuest1.任务对白2: As a captain in the King's Elite Guard, one of my duties is to build alliances.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Susan has opened a portal to the Dark Forest.  The kindly forest folk who live there remain unseen by human eyes, but are preyed upon by large spiders.  If you could go kill 3 spiders and report back to me, it would significantly improve relations between our two cultures.
xmlDataQuest1.任务确认2: Gran will supply you with equipment.  You need weapons and armor if you want to help out around here.
xmlDataQuest1.任务拒绝2: Scared?  That is a serious problem for a hero…
xmlDataQuest1.任务未完成2: Enter the portal, kill three spiders, then report back to me.
xmlDataQuest1.任务完成2: Well done!  Here is something for your trouble…
xmlDataQuest1.任务简要3: Kill 7 spiders in the Dark Forest.  Gain a level, assign ability and skill points, then talk to Paul.
xmlDataQuest1.任务对白3: Hunting spiders in the Dark Forest does much to improve our relations with the Fair Folk.  Kill 7 more spiders, but take the time to demonstrate your prowess to anyone who might be watching.  Attain a higher level, and push your abilities and skills to the limit.  Once you have done all this, return to me and we shall talk.
xmlDataQuest1.任务确认3: I need not remind you of the importance of proper provisions in battle.  Susan will supply you with the potions you need to stay healthy in combat.
xmlDataQuest1.任务未完成3: Kill 7 spiders in the Dark Forest.  Gain a level, assign ability and skill points, then we'll talk!
xmlDataQuest1.任务完成3: Well done.  A hero must be willing to act on faith, and take risks to help those he may never meet.  You have earned this reward!
xmlDataQuest1.任务简要4: Enchant your weapon with Ice damage.
xmlDataQuest1.任务对白4: Through the art of combination, we bring together elements to produce powerful results.  Combination can greatly enhance you equipment!
xmlDataQuest1.任务确认4: Take these 2 Small Wind Crystals and a Stone of Blessing.  Combine them with your weapon to enchant it with Ice damage.
xmlDataQuest1.任务拒绝4: Don't be afraid to study and practice!
xmlDataQuest1.任务未完成4: Please combine 2 Small Wind Crystals and a Stone of Blessing with your weapon.
xmlDataQuest1.任务完成4: You have talent!  Any time you want to combine something, come see me.  Use the "?" on the combination panel to review details.
xmlDataQuest1.任务简要5: Help Anna trade Chung a piece of candy for a crystal.
xmlDataQuest1.任务对白5: Can you help Anna?  Anna is learning combination from Susan.  Yesterday I made a mistake and wasted a crystal.  I don't want to ask Susan, because...  Can you help me get one from Chung?  He likes to trade!  Here is the last piece of candy my mom left me...  Will you trade Chung this candy for a small wind crystal?  Can you do that for me?
xmlDataQuest1.任务确认5: Thanks, big brother!  Here's the candy!
xmlDataQuest1.任务拒绝5: I'm too shy to ask…  He might say no…
xmlDataQuest1.任务未完成5: I hope Chung can say yes to you!
xmlDataQuest1.任务完成5: Wow!  I get the crystal and the candy!  I will study hard, and make something useful for you, too, some day!
xmlDataQuest1.任务简要6: Collect 12 samples of spider venom from the Dark Forest.  Deliver them to Susan.
xmlDataQuest1.任务对白6: The toxic gas rising from the dungeon is making people ill...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Inhaling too much of the poisoned air could kill you!  You cannot enter the dungeon.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Susan has been working on a way to immunize us from the effects of the foul miasma...  Can you help her?
xmlDataQuest1.任务确认6: Great!  She mentioned needing 12 samples of spider venom to complete the potion.  Please, go talk to Susan and give her what she needs.
xmlDataQuest1.任务拒绝6: Sickness and death…  Who can save us?
xmlDataQuest1.任务未完成6: Did you get 12 bottles of spider venom?
xmlDataQuest1.任务完成6: You brought the venom?  Excellent!  I can make enough Antivenom for the whole village, and nobody need fear the poison gasses again!  I'll let you know when it's done…
xmlDataQuest1.任务简要7: Find Kimura and invite him to join your quest.
xmlDataQuest1.任务对白7: Kimura has expressed an interest in joining you on your missions.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] He has been training hard.  His skill and determination gives Kimura the potential to become a great hero.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Will you please invite him to join you in your quest?
xmlDataQuest1.任务确认7: I expect great things of both of you!
xmlDataQuest1.任务拒绝7: You can let me know your decision later…
xmlDataQuest1.任务未完成7: Why not talk to Kimura?  It can't hurt to have an ally in the dungeon.
xmlDataQuest1.任务完成7: It is wonderful to see young people working together![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Susan has prepared the Antivenom.  We should all go see her now.

xmlDataQuest1_1.任务简要8: Ask Susan to help cure a petrified elf.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务对白8: A petrified elf woman in the dungeon?  If she is one of the great heroes of old, restoring her could save us all![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Ask Susan if she can help cure the elf!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务确认8: Go quickly!  Susan can cure that elf, I'm sure of it!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务拒绝8: You are the only one who can accurately describe her condition…
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务未完成8: Consult with Susan.  Tell her what you know, and she can figure out a way to cure that elf!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务完成8: The elf you saved is the legendary Celest!  Our chances of surviving the dangers ahead have dramatically improved.  Thank you![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] We must have faith that heroes will rise to stem the tide of darkness…
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务简要9: Search the dungeon for The Book of Omen.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务对白9: It has come to my attention that The Book of Omen can be found in the dungeon![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The Book of Omen contains much wisdom.  It is written by the heroes of old.  It might teach us how to defeat Ssyba!  It lies somewhere in the dungeon below...  Will you retrieve it for me?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务确认9: Search carefully!  We must have that book!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务拒绝9: Please reconsider.  The information in that book could save us!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务未完成9: Any luck finding The Book of Omen?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务完成9: Amazing!  With the Book of Omen in our possession, much will be revealed!  Please accept this token of our gratitude.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务简要10: Defeat Guardian Onim on the 7th floor of the dungeon.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务对白10: I must tell you of a great danger that lies ahead!  Anyone who descends deep into the dungeon will encounter the Three Guardians.  The first Guardian is Minotaur Onim, a master of fire and thunder magic.  He awaits you on 7th floor.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The second Guardian is a Beholder that watches over the 17th floor.  Cerberus, the final Guardian, dwells on the 27th floor.  Furthermore, your path is barred by magic seals...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Fortunately, I can conjure the elemental Yooseki stones you will need break the seals.  I already possess the Fire Yooseki.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Are you ready to take it, and face Onim?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务确认10: Carry the Fire Yooseki to the seal on the 7th floor, and challenge Onim!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务拒绝10: Return to me when you are ready to face this challenge…
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务未完成10: Prepare well.  Onim is a dangerous opponent.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务简要11: Defeat the Beholder on the 17th floor.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务对白11: The second Guardian is even more dangerous.  The Beholder who lurks on the 17th floor is famous for tormenting heroes with his thunder and poison magic.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] You may be forced to fight him to the death.  Are you prepared to do so?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务确认11: Here is the Water Yooseki you will need to open the seal on the 17th floor.  Take care!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务未完成11: The Beholder is a cunning enemy.  Good luck!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务对白12: What cliff?  Oh, yeah.  That chasm is easily crossed, if you're willing to pay![*DONT DELETE THIS!*]I need 20 lizardman tails, but they won't sell them to me.  My buyer is getting angry.  You will have to kill them to get the tails, but that's business!  Anyway, they hunt humans...  Give me the tails, and I'll give you a crossing!  Do you accept?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务确认12: Deal!  Now go get those 20 lizardman tails for me!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务未完成12: Where are my lizardman tails?  I need 20 of them!  Take the path behind me and start chopping!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务完成12: 20 lizardman tails!  I'll be rich!  Ahem…  I mean, maybe someone will pay a little for these…  Ok, let's see about getting you across that chasm…
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务简要13: Find an old captain's ring for Paul.  The ring is carved with the initials "R.R."
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务对白13: According to The Book of Omen, one of my predecessors rescued a dwarven king during a battle in the dungeon, but lost his arm in the process.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] It is my duty to see that the old captain of the guard's signet ring is returned to his family.  His ring bore the initials "R.R."  Will you keep an eye out for it during your exploration of the dungeon?  Will you help me honor the memory of our heroic forefathers?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务确认13: I hope you are able to find it…
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务拒绝13: If you don't have the time…
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务未完成13: Did you find the ring?  The Book mentions that it is a magic ring, so maybe an evil mage has taken it?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务完成13: You found the ring?  I hope it was not too much trouble.  Large or small, acts of honor will be remembered.  Please, have this!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务简要14: Show the Knight's Badge to the cursed Knight and return it to Paul.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务对白14: You met a cursed knight?  He spoke to you!?  He must have had a great sense of duty in life...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] My Knight's Badge is a holy symbol that represents my honor, and my word.  Showing it to him might help him break free of the curse.  Do you want to try using my Badge?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务确认14: Command this Knight to accept honorable discharge, and get some rest.  Report back to me once your mission is complete.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务拒绝14: All right, you can try something else first…
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务未完成14: Did you try showing the Knight my Badge?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务完成14: We have freed one of the great heroes of our past.  May he rest in peace…
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务简要15: Defeat the Guardian Cerberus on the 27th floor.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务对白15: On the 27th floor, you will find Cerberus, the final Guardian.  Do not underestimate his power.  His ice and poison magic has felled many a demon.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The other Guardians were nothing compared to him.  To survive a fight with Cerberus, you must be in peak condition, and carry plenty of potions![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Are you ready to face this awesome foe?
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务确认15: Take the Field Yooseki.  I admire your courage.  Good luck.
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务拒绝15: We do not know another way…
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务未完成15: I have faith that you will emerge victorious!
xmlDataQuest1_1.任务完成15: You amaze me.  Let us hope your most difficult battles are behind you...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] What?  The Cerberus was kind to warn us, but if Zark has already made it so far, how can we hope to stop him in time?  What will become of the world…

xmlDataQuest2.任务简要16: Find another key for the altar gate.
xmlDataQuest2.任务对白16: I'm so glad you've returned safely.  Any word on Paul?  He's dead?!  No!  What about Anna??  Still haven't found her… [*DONT DELETE THIS!*]  It is an endless nightmare...  now is Anna missing...  Paul dead... [*DONT DELETE THIS!*] What? You need two keys to open the altar gate?  Hmm...  can you show me the one you took from the Cerberus?
xmlDataQuest2.任务确认16: There is something familiar about this key...  Please, may I examine it more closely?[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I know!  My amulet looks just like it!  My father told me to give it to the one who would deliver us from evil.  Could this be the second key?[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Take it!  There may still be time to prevent Ssyba's revival and save Anna!
xmlDataQuest2.任务拒绝16: If you show me the key, I might be able to help…
xmlDataQuest2.任务未完成16: Does the key work?  Is the gate open?  I can't stop thinking about Paul and Anna…  Paul's wounds were so deep, but he insisted on trying to save Anna…  I see now that the knight's way is to protect the innocent, even if it means death…
xmlDataQuest2.任务对白17: You have opened the altar gate?  Excellent!  Know this:  the final altar atop the Burning Temple is a portal that leads directly to the chamber where Ssyba is sealed, but you cannot pass through safely without my spells to protect you.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*]Shall we go to the final portal now?
xmlDataQuest2.任务拒绝17: The portal was fashioned so that nobody could pass through without death magic shrouding their life force…  Let me cast the spell to send you to the final floor.
xmlDataQuest2.任务未完成17: Have you passed through the altar?  Did you find Zark?  I can keep the way open, and channel my energies to keep you alive, but the rest is up to you.  I know you can do it!
xmlDataQuest2.任务简要18: Find the "Doom Hammer" created by Gran's ancestors.
xmlDataQuest2.任务对白18: Long ago, my grandfather crafted many of the best weapons and armor used by the heroes of legend.  It is said that he forged these great works with a powerful hammer, called Doom.  It was his most prized possession.  Items crafted by Doom's power gained mysterious attributes...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Tragically, Grandfather lost his favorite hammer during an expedition into the dungeon.  I'm not sure why, but he never tried to recover it...  Maybe he just thought the war was ending, and there was no need for Doom's power anymore...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] War has returned.  With the Doom Hammer, I might be able to create more powerful items--maybe I can forge the greatest weapon of all!  If you find the Doom Hammer, can you bring it back to me?
xmlDataQuest2.任务确认18: Thank you, my friend!  Please return Doom to me as soon as you find it!
xmlDataQuest2.任务拒绝18: Oh…  I understand…  too busy saving the world to look for an old hammer…
xmlDataQuest2.任务未完成18: Have you found the Doom Hammer?
xmlDataQuest2.任务完成18: Incredible!  You found it!  Strange that such power could have come from something that appears so ordinary...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*]  Ha!  I think I understand...  "Doom" is not the name of the hammer, it is my grandfather's legendary title!  Grandfather Doom Hammer![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] That he once held this hammer...  I feel that he is near me.  I must work harder!  I will uphold the honor of our family name![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Thank you for finding the hammer for me, my friends! Take this!
xmlDataQuest2.任务简要19: Collect 10 pairs of bat wings for Geb.
xmlDataQuest2.任务对白19: What?  You ask me if I've seen a hammer called Doom?  An old blacksmith's hammer, right?  It's right here in my backpack!  It took such a long time to acquire this particular item...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Give it to you?  No way!  I am a merchant!  I bargain, I trade...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Seems you really want it...  how about we make a deal?  I'll give you a discount.  How does a million gold sound??[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Wow!  I can see that humans are quite sensitive about gold, but I like a challenge...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I'll trade you this hammer for 10 pairs of bat wings!  Bring me the wings, and you can have this "wonderful" hammer...
xmlDataQuest2.任务确认19: Deal!  Go now, my bat hunters!  Bring me my wings!
xmlDataQuest2.任务拒绝19: I'm still waiting…  Where are my wings?  Get back to work!
xmlDataQuest2.任务未完成19: I guess you must not really want that hammer.
xmlDataQuest2.任务完成19: You work quickly!  Now, about Doom's hammer…  Here you go!  All yours!
xmlDataQuest2.任务简要20: Scour the dungeon traps for treasure left behind by unfortunate heroes.
xmlDataQuest2.任务对白20: In case you didn't already know, this dungeon is full of traps.  Arrows fire from the walls, flames burst from the floor, and generally horrible things happen if you aren't careful. [*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The fiends baited the first set of traps to lure people in, which means you are going to learn about traps and get paid at the same time![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] So here is what you do:  go tinker around with the first set of traps, figure out how they work and how to avoid getting killed, snatch the good stuff from them, and I'll throw in a little extra as a reward.  What do you say?
xmlDataQuest2.任务确认20: That's the spirit!  Test each trap and try to understand how it works, and you won't get seriously hurt…
xmlDataQuest2.任务未完成20: Get through all the traps, collect the treasure, then come see me!
xmlDataQuest2.任务完成20: Smooth moves, man!  You passed the traps and got the treasure?  Nice!  Here, take this, too.
xmlDataQuest2.任务简要21: Find the Rose Necklace and bring it to Chung.
xmlDataQuest2.任务对白21: Listen…  I have a secret.  Please, don't laugh.  There's this girl, Mary...  She loves roses, and I want to give her a special gift.  I've been searching for the Rose Necklace to give to her, as a token of my love.  If you find it, I'll pay you handsomely for it.  Deal?
xmlDataQuest2.任务确认21: Thank you, my friend!  You understand love!
xmlDataQuest2.任务拒绝21: You won't help?  Oh, my dear Mary…  Only the Rose Necklace can express my true feelings for you…
xmlDataQuest2.任务未完成21: Have you found the Rose Necklace?  If I had it, I know I'd have to confidence to tell her how I feel…
xmlDataQuest2.任务完成21: You found it!!!  It's perfect!  I can't wait to see Mary's eyes light up when I give it to her!  If she accepts my love, I'll give you a lifetime discount on all future purchases!  See how love changes a man?
xmlDataQuest2.任务简要22: Help Gran retrieve his ancestor's armor.
xmlDataQuest2.任务对白22: My skills are improving, but I could really use some examples of Grandfather's greatest works.  Grandad gave all his creations away and focused on making tools and toys after the war...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Somewhere in the dungeon, there has to be an example of his best work left behind...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Can you do me a favor?  If you find any armor marked "T.C Craft", could you bring it back to me?  T.C. was what all his guild buddies called Grandad.
xmlDataQuest2.任务确认22: I really appreciate it.  Once I get my hands on one of Grandfather's famous suits of armor, I know I can build upon his work.
xmlDataQuest2.任务拒绝22: A pity.  You are the only one who can help me find that armor.
xmlDataQuest2.任务未完成22: If you find any armor marked "T.C." you'll bring it to me, yes?
xmlDataQuest2.任务完成22: Gramp's armor!  This is great!  Let me see it...  The mix of materials, the shape, the precise crafting…  Awesome work!! [*DONT DELETE THIS!*] It would have been decades before I could have matched this craftsmanship, but now I have a chance to duplicate Grandfather's work!  I'm sure I can create even more powerful items soon![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Thank you so much!  Here, please take this.

xmlDataQuest2_2.任务简要23: Save up 10,000 gold and show it to Chung.
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务对白23: If you can save money, you can buy great things.  Saving a huge pile of gold can be fun!  Save up 10,000 gold, come to me, and I will give you a super cool treasure![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Do we have a deal?
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务未完成23: Keep working at it, and you'll save up 10,000 gold in no time!
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务完成23: Nice to see that young people know how to save their money!  Are you ready for your super cool treasure?  Here you go!
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务对白24: Hee hee...  Anna has a secret![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] After mom and dad died, the villagers became all my moms and dads.  Even when I am very bad, they are still nice to me...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The reason I asked you to get things earlier was so I could make gifts for everyone!  I did all the combining myself!  It will be a big surprise!  Will you help me give people their gifts?  Anna is too shy to do it alone…
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务简要25: Discover the combination formula hidden in the elvish poem:  "On a day without wind, she lays in the field, her flowing song is a blessing."
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务对白25: The Book of Omen reveals much about the art of combination. [*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I am convinced that the elvish poem on this page is also a formula.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] The poem reads:  "On a day without wind, she lays in the field, her flowing song is a blessing."[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Will you help me make sense of it?
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务确认25: Thanks.  This poem is a real puzzle…
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务未完成25: "On a day without wind, she lays in the field, her flowing song is a blessing..."  I wonder how this relates to combination?
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务完成25: You figured out the meaning of the poem?  How clever you are!
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务简要26: Deliver 20 centaur's horns to Susan so she can cure Anna's illness.
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务对白26: Anna has fallen ill, under a foul curse cast by the Beholder.  If Anna grows any weaker, she may die!  I can cure her, but I need 20 centaur horns for the medicine.  Can you get them for me?
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务确认26: Bless you.  Bring me 20 centaur horns as quick as you can.  The curse is draining her life force.  Anna could die at any moment!
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务拒绝26: Please reconsider…  Anna's life is at stake!
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务未完成26: Did you get 20 centaur horns yet?  You must help me free her from the curse, or there is little hope Anna will survive…
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务完成26: I'll start brewing the potion immediately.  Anna will be well, and protected from future curses of this type!  Take this small reward for your kindness.
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务27-2: Defend the village from enemy assault.
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务27-3: Gather supplies, don your armor, and ready your weapons.
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务简要28: Explore the dungeon, become an 8th level hero, and return to Paul.
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务对白28: You see that dungeon entrance near the old well?  Rumor has it that skilled heroes have already begun searching it.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I need someone to explore the dungeon and report back their findings.  If you meet any 8th level heroes, bring them back and we'll try to recruit them![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Will you take this mission?
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务确认28: Fantastic!  Take care in the dungeon.  Retreat if it looks too dangerous!
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务拒绝28: We'll talk when you're ready.  If you see anyone who looks  strong enough for the job, send them my way!
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务未完成28: Any news of the dungeon?  Did you find an 8th level hero?
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务完成28: What?  The dungeon sounds quite dangerous…  Oh!  You are the level 8 hero?!  Yes, I see that you are!  Here, take this!
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务简要29: Search for Paul in the dungeon.
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务对白29: Paul is in great danger!  He has gone after Anna, who is surely being taken to the deepest floor of the dungeon.  I fear that she will become the instrument of Ssyba's return...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I will protect the village!  Go after Paul and save Anna!
xmlDataQuest2_2.任务拒绝29: I understand, if you must prepare…

xmlDataScene1.剧情11-1: The potions are ready!  Antitoxin will immunize you from the effects of the poison miasma seeping from the dungeon.
xmlDataScene1.剧情11-2: Antitoxin?  Thank you, Susan...  Whoo-ah!  Most bracing!
xmlDataScene1.剧情11-3: You are so good to us, Susan.  Cheers!
xmlDataScene1.剧情11-4: I'm not too fond of medicine…  Ok, here goes!  Bottoms up!  Whooooo!
xmlDataScene1.剧情11-5: This will prevent the poison gas from harming us?  It's priceless!  You sure it's free?  Ok, just don't try to charge me later!
xmlDataScene1.剧情11-6: Anna doesn't like medicine…  Ok, I will drink it and like it…
xmlDataScene1.剧情11-7: Whoa!  I feel great!  Buuuurrp!  Excuse me!  Drink up, buddy!
xmlDataScene1.剧情11-8: After drinking the potion, you will not be harmed by the miasma, and can safely enter the dungeon.  However, the dungeon is totally unsafe, so be careful!
xmlDataScene1.剧情21-1: …[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] You and me together can do a lot of good.  We should team up![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] It can't hurt to have an archer to watch your back, right?[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] So, what do you think?  Partners?[*DONT DELETE THIS!*]...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Yes?  You accept?  Ok then, partner!
xmlDataScene1.剧情21-2: Haha!  This is great![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] So! The epic tale of Kimura and his faithful ally begins![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Oh, yeah!  I better get my things!
xmlDataScene1.剧情22-1: What a fine elf statue!  The artist really captured her natural beauty...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Whoa!  This isn't art.  This is petrification!  An elf woman has been turned to stone![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] This is quite a discovery.  Maybe Wayne has a clue about what to do, eh?
xmlDataScene1.剧情23-1: I guess we'll see if Susan's potion works…
xmlDataScene1.剧情23-3: …Who are you?  Where am I?[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] How long has it been…  Tell me, has Ssyba been sealed away!  I must know![*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Forgive me.  I am Celest.  My mission is to...  What?  100 years passed, and Ssyba may soon be freed?  Ooh...  Perhaps being stoned has addled my mind...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I can rest in the village of Arkenveil?  Very well.  Lead the way.
xmlDataScene1.剧情23-4: To think, the Great War has been over for 100 years...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] It was my priviledge to fight alongside the heroes who opposed Ssyba's tyranny.  Unfortunately, my group was petrified by one of Ssyba's spells.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] My magic sustained me, while my comrades crumbled to dust...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Thank you so much for freeing me from the stone.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I was shocked to hear that a man intends to free Ssyba once more.  Ssyba is a vile monster who speaks only lies.  All anyone can expect from Ssyba is torment and death.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I will do what I can to help you.  At the moment, even consciousness requires effort, but I sense that my magic will return to me if I remain here.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] By channeling the wild magic in the stones, I can summon the power to heal you.  Do not hesitate to come to me if you are injured.[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] I am certain that we shall set things right...
xmlDataScene1.剧情31-2: The Book of Omen!!  This is what Wayne has been looking for!  Hmn…  strange letters.  We should take it to Wayne.
xmlDataScene1.剧情31-3: Omens?  I can't make sense of this thing!  I wonder if Wayne can read it?
xmlDataScene1.剧情31-4: The Book of Omen!  This book will guide us to victory.  Through it, we will gain the wisdom of the ancients and learn how defeat the monsters and defend our homes.
xmlDataScene1.剧情31-5: Hey maybe you could write something about us in there!
xmlDataScene1.剧情31-6: I must read it carefully, and confer with the others…  Yes, much to do…
xmlDataScene1.剧情32-1: That goblin with a backpack…  I think he wants to talk.
xmlDataScene1.剧情32-2: It's been a long time since I've seen humans.
xmlDataScene1.剧情32-3: You remind me of my old buddy, "Die, Die, Die!  One shot, one kill!"
xmlDataScene1.剧情32-5: Good old Eagle Eye Kimura used to talk that way, back in the day.
xmlDataScene1.剧情32-7: Any relation to old Ray Kimura?  Heh, I can see the resemblance!  He must have been your grandpappy!
xmlDataScene1.剧情32-8: Grandpa was a humble hero like me…  How did you know him?  Who are you?
xmlDataScene1.剧情32-9: I'm Geb.  I'm a merchant.  I used to sell things to the heroes of the last big war, but once they won, they locked me down here.  After that, I started doing business with the monsters.
xmlDataScene1.剧情32-10: Now it seems the dungeon gate is open.  Great!  Monsters and humans, all customers are welcome!
xmlDataScene1.剧情33-1: Defilers!  Invaders!  Your journey ends here!
xmlDataScene1.剧情33-2: Wow, you are a big one!  Don't mind us.  We were just leaving…
xmlDataScene1.剧情33-3: Leaving this world!  I shall crush you!
xmlDataScene1.剧情34-1: You have beaten me, but you cannot defeat us all...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] Lord Zark…  I have failed you!
xmlDataScene1.剧情34-2: What was that about?  Was he in love with Lord Zark?[*DONT DELETE THIS!*] It looked like he was crying in the end…
xmlDataScene1.剧情34-3: He dropped a letter.  We should take it back to Wayne.
xmlDataScene1.剧情341-1: Minotaur Onim is dead?  He was one of The Three Guardians described in the Book of Omen.  Zark must have somehow corrupted him…
xmlDataScene1.剧情341-2: Ah, I see you have a letter that bears Zark's seal!
xmlDataScene1.剧情341-3: It reads:  "Evil humans will invade the dungeon to hunt your people.  I hope this letter reaches you in time, so that you may protect your homeland.  Friend, I hope we can work together to restore your nation!  --Zark"
xmlDataScene1.剧情341-4: No doubt Zark will lay other traps for you.  We must learn the full scope of his plan and stop him before he revives Ssyba!
xmlDataScene1.剧情341-5: You had no choice.  Ssyba's agents easily corrupt the weak-willed.  Though imprisoned, the Devil's influence can turn anguished hearts toward evil.  Approach the remaining Guardians with caution.
xmlDataScene1.剧情41-1: Where do you think you're going?  I have my eye on you!  Ha-ha!
xmlDataScene1.剧情41-2: Listen!  We don't want any trouble!  We're the good guys!
xmlDataScene1.剧情41-3: I bet you are good…  tasting…  I'll save your eyeballs for dessert!
xmlDataScene1.剧情41-6: The bow is quicker than the eye!
xmlDataScene1.剧情42-3: My power is fading…  Where are you?
xmlDataScene1.剧情42-4: All black…  Blindness…  I don't want to die…
xmlDataScene1.剧情421-1: You survived a fight with The Beholder?  Amazing!  We might stand a chance after all!
xmlDataScene1.剧情421-2: The Beholder was a cruel and vengeful monster.  You have proven to be a most formidable team.  Remain loyal to each other, and nothing can stop you.

xmlDataScene1_1.剧情51-1: That cliff…  I feel dizzy…  I can't go that way!  I have a problem with heights...
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情51-2: Jump?  You must be joking!  We'd die for sure.  There must be another way…
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情51-3: If only we could ask the locals…  That goblin merchant Geb might know a way across.  We should ask him!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情511-1: I need 20 lizard man tails!  Hurry!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情511-2: Take the path behind me to find lizardmen.  Harvest 20 of their tails, and bring them to me!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情52-2: Your path is revealed!  Walk to the magic circle beside the cliff and it will send you to the other side!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情53-1: Hello, Sir Knight.  We would like to pass, if it's ok with you.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情53-3: Why not just build a wall?  You must let some people through, right?
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情53-4: I can only be freed of this cursed existence by the order of a True Knight.  Show me a sign that you are a True Knight, and you may pass.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情53-6: I have no memory other than my duty.  I am caught between the man I was, and the curse placed upon me…  Help me depart this world in peace.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情53-7: Ok, go jump off a cliff!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情53-9: So stubborn!  Maybe someone in the village knows how to deal with this?
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情54-1: The badge of a True Knight.  I am relieved of my duty, yes?
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情54-2: The curse is broken.  Thank you friends…
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情54-4: That was strange.  Did the badge free him, or his own mind?  We can return the badge to Paul and ask.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情55-1: Everyone has been so nice to Anna.  I love you all.  I made gifts for everyone.  Thank you for being so good to me.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情55-2: A gift from Anna!  Thank you, my dear sweet girl!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情55-3: Well made…  Anna, it has been a priviledge to watch you learn and grow.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情55-4: I accept this with serenity, child, and will keep it well.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情55-5: You have performed some tricky combinations here, Anna.  I'd like to review what you've done later.  Great work!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情55-7: So, this gift is free, right?  Ah, yes, very thoughtful child…
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情55-8: Big brother, here is a gift for you, too!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情56-1: Grrrr…  I cannot see you clearly through your evil magic.  If you depart now, you may live.  If you stay, you die!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情56-2: Sniff...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*]Grrr...[*DONT DELETE THIS!*]Still here?[*DONT DELETE THIS!*]…
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情56-3: Trying to play a trick on me!  I will feast on your flesh!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情56-4: I--I'm just too scared to move...
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情57-1: As my life ebbs, my mind is cleared.  I see you now.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情57-2: So Zark intends to free Ssyba?  Take my key.  Should all else fail, find the altar below, and enter.  Beware!  Once you pass through the altar, you may never leave…
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情57-3: …but first, I have caught scent of a group of monsters preparing to attack the human settlement above…  They do Zark's bidding…  a vessel…
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情57-4: You may yet arrive before them if you use a portal…
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情57-6: We've got to get back to the village!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情571-1: Did you truly defeat the Cerberus?
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情571-2: Zark turned The Guardian against us.  As it lay dying, it was freed from the corruption and told us what to do!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情571-3: I wonder…  what did it say?
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情571-4: The Cerberus gave us a key and told us where to go, but also said that Zark is going to attack the village!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情571-5: What?!  Sound the alarm!  To arms!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情571-6: Paul, your duty is to protect the villagers.  Leave the monsters to us.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情571-7: I'm feeling much better…  but, very well.  I'll keep them safe.
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情571-8: Sister Elf!  It is truly an honor to fight by your side!
xmlDataScene1_1.剧情571-9: Comrades, it is I who am honored.  Please, gather your potions and prepare for battle!

xmlDataScene2.剧情572-1: I sense an evil presence approaching…
xmlDataScene2.剧情572-2: If we work together, we can take them!
xmlDataScene2.剧情572-3: I will lead the villagers to safety.  Celest, young heroes…  all our hopes rest on you...
xmlDataScene2.剧情572-4: I will protect the innocent, even if it means my death!
xmlDataScene2.剧情572-5: Positions everyone!  The enemy is upon us!
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-1: Uh…  Is that it?  Why did they stop attacking?  Afraid of my skills, perhaps?  Haha!  A good fight!
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-2: You fought well, Kimura.  However, there may be some other reason they stopped the attack…
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-3: All this praise…  you're making me blush…
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-4: At last, it is over.  Congratulations to all of you on a battle well fought!  Paul, I saw you chasing a group of monsters…
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-5: They hit us hard!  Glad to see you all made it!
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-8: I can't be sure…  Anna!  Everyone, Anna is missing!
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-10: It was such a mess…  Did anyone see anything?
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-12: Damn!  It's my fault!  I should have stayed with her…
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-13: It is possible that the attack was a ruse to steal Anna.  The darkest ritual capable of breaking Ssyba's seal involves binding him to a child's soul…
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-14: They pretended to attack, just to steal Anna?
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-15: I have to bring her back!
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-16: Paul, it isn't your fault.  Get healed up, and we'll go together.
xmlDataScene2.剧情58-18: Paul is a brave knight, but I don't think he is strong enough to face the beasts of the dungeon alone.  Please find Paul and Anna, and bring them back safely!
xmlDataScene2.剧情61-1: You…  came…  I caught Zark and his guards here…  Slowed them down a bit…  Zark had Anna!  He intends to…  (cough)  …use Anna to free the devil…
xmlDataScene2.剧情61-2: Don't speak!  We're taking you back to the village.
xmlDataScene2.剧情61-3: Nothing... can save me now...  the curse… (cough)...  Zark went through that gate…  ...Ssyba is there!  You must stop him now!
xmlDataScene2.剧情62-1: The altar gate?  Let's try the key we got from the Cerberus!  What?  Two key holes, but only one key!  Are we stuck?
xmlDataScene2.剧情62-2: To come so far, and be a key short…  That's life I guess…  The bad guys win sometimes…
xmlDataScene2.剧情62-3: Never accept defeat!  Lets head back to the village!  Wayne and Celest might have some clues…
xmlDataScene2.剧情63-1: Nice!  I knew it would work!  Time to stick it to the bad guys!  Are you pumped?  Are you ready for action?  I know I am!
xmlDataScene2.剧情71-2: Move, you blasted hunk of rock!
xmlDataScene2.剧情71-4: Uh…  maybe we should go see if Celest has any ideas?
xmlDataScene2.剧情72-1: Stand still.  I am going to cast a spell…
xmlDataScene2.剧情72-6: It is done.  You should be able to pass through to the final floor where Ssyba's languishes.  Zark is sure to be close by.  Do not hesitate to kill him.  The future of our world depends on your decisiveness.
xmlDataScene2.剧情72-7: So its down to us against Zark?  If we lose, the bad guys will rule the world, right?
xmlDataScene2.剧情72-8: Win or lose, I'm with you, brother!  Let's go!
xmlDataScene2.剧情73-1: Behold your doom!  I am Ssyba!  Kneel before your Master, and…  Why are you looking around?  Am I not sufficiently impressive!?
xmlDataScene2.剧情73-2: Watch out, Zark must be here, too!
xmlDataScene2.剧情73-3: HA, HA, HA!!!  Oh, I killed that one and turned him to the skeleton king.  He will live forever...   That is the only immortality you worms can hope for!
xmlDataScene2.剧情73-4: I find it so amusing that my old joke is still floating around…  Yes, I wrote the Legend of the Immortal myself.  This Zark was just the latest fool in a long line of idiots, reeled in like a fish on a hook.  Prepare to join him!
xmlDataScene2.剧情73-6: Dinner has never asked so many question…  The little girl?  I have her soul, of course.  They really don't teach much in school these days, do they…  You could restore her, if I died…  Unfortunately, that is quite impossible!
xmlDataScene2.剧情73-8: HA, HA!  Unbowed heads must be chopped!
xmlDataScene2.剧情74-1: AAARGH!  It is inconceivable that two gnats such as you could beat me!  My body…  the pull of my origin…  I must resist…
xmlDataScene2.剧情74-2: No!!  I will not leave this world!  It is mine!  I will have my vengeance.  You will grow old and die, and human weakness will free me once more!
xmlDataScene2.剧情74-3: If you break the seal... if you stop this…  I will give you my power!  Obey me, and I will open the universe to you!  You are fools to deny me!
xmlDataScene2.剧情74-4: AAAHHH!  Ah…!  Ahhhhhhhhhhh… (Ssyba is sealed again.)
xmlDataScene2.剧情74-5: Uh…  I don't feel so good…
xmlDataScene2.剧情74-6: Anna!!  Great!  Let's get you out of here!

xmlDataScene2_2.剧情加21-1: That platform looks pretty old…  I wonder what it is used for…
xmlDataScene2_2.剧情加21-3: Never mind!  Leave it!  There are so many other places to explore!
xmlDataScene2_2.剧情加22-1: Another platform!  What could it be?
xmlDataScene2_2.剧情加22-3: I know!  A portal!  Stand on the platform, press a button, and bam!  Teleportation!
xmlDataScene2_2.剧情加22-4: Very convenient.  Saves time, for sure!  It shall from this day forward be known as The Kimura Dungeon Express!
xmlDataScene2_2.剧情加22-5: It just shuddered and made rude sounds…  Don't like your new name, Mr. Portal?  Too bad!  I own you now.
xmlDataScene2_2.特殊剧情1-2: Heh, heh…  so, who are you?
xmlDataScene2_2.特殊剧情1-3: Oh!  I forgot to introduce myself!  I'm Kimura, a famous hero.  No doubt, you've heard of me?
xmlDataScene2_2.特殊剧情1-4: I heard war was brewing, so I jumped in!  Turns out the monsters down here are tougher than I expected.  I was just about to figure out which way to go when I got surrounded, then you came along to help out.
xmlDataScene2_2.特殊剧情1-5: Well, since we're down here together... we should team up!
xmlDataScene2_2.特殊剧情2-1: Oh, Bernie…  My friend…  what have they done to you?
xmlDataScene2_2.特殊剧情2-2: I'll soon be overcome by the curse.  Remember me as I was, and help me die with dignity…
xmlDataScene2_2.特殊剧情2-8: Peace be upon you, my friend.  I will avenge you!
xmlDataScene2_2.特殊剧情3-2: Looks like this is as far as I go…
xmlDataScene2_2.特殊剧情3-4: Kimura, you have grown so much...  You will make an excellent captain…

xmlDataScene2_2.教程1: Use W/↑ A/← S/↓ D/→ to move, Space to talk/investigate, J to attack, and K to jump/cancel.
xmlDataScene2_2.教程2: You can learn much by talking to the villagers.  Paul is most eager to speak with you.
xmlDataScene2_2.教程3: Go talk to Gran, the blacksmith.  Be sure to consult with him often.  A hero needs quality equipment.
xmlDataScene2_2.教程4: Susan has opened a gateway that leads to danger.  Pass through and kill 3 spiders.
xmlDataScene2_2.教程6: Talk to Susan.  She has something for you.
xmlDataScene2_2.教程7: Go to the Dark Forest and collect 12 bottles of spider venom.
xmlDataScene2_2.教程8: Grab a weapon, shield, and cap from Gran, then go talk to Wayne.
xmlDataScene2_2.教程9: Kill 7 spiders in the Dark Forest.  Be sure to properly allocate you Attribute and Skill points.
xmlDataScene2_2.教程12: Mayor Wayne is looking for you.  Talk to him.

xmlDataSkill.技能文字1: Falchion Proficiency (Passive):  Increase damage and attack rate when using falchions. Also applied to dual wield.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字2: Axe Proficiency (Passive):  Increase damage and attack rate when using axes. Also applied to dual wield.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字3: Sword Proficiency (Passive):  Increase damage and attack rate when using swords. Also applied to dual wield.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字4: Heroic Stamina (Passive):  Allows you to carry more weight.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字5: Inner Strength (Passive):  Increase HP & SP Recovery speed.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字6: Battle Frenzy (Passive):  8% chance per skill level to become berzerk during close combat.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字7: Enlightenment (Passive):  +5 to all attributes per upgrade level.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字8: Falchion Final Blow (Passive):  Attacking rapidly with a falchion triggers extra fierce slashes. Can combo with Falchion Flurry.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字9: Axe Final Blow (Passive):  Swift axe attacks trigger a deadly axe chop. Can combo with Axe Reaper.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字10: Sword Final Blow (Passive):  Quickly attacking with a sword triggers an additional powerful strike. Can combo with Sword Lunge.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字11: Falchion Flurry (Active):  Rapidly slash a single enemy. Can combo with Falchion Final Blow.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字12: Axe Reaper (Active): A single powerful blow that damages all nearby enemies. Can combo with Axe Final Blow.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字13: Sword Lunge (Active):  A powerful thrust that damages enemies in front of you. Can combo with Sword Final Blow.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字14: Hurricane I (Active):  A spinning attack that damages all enemies in range.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字15: Hurricane II (Active):  A more powerful spinning attack that damages and knocks back all enemies in range.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字16: Blade Storm (Active):  Deal intense damage and knock back all enemies in range as you whirl and move through them for several seconds.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字17: Force Wave (Active):  Hurl a wave of pure energy from your weapon to damage enemies in front of you.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字18: Elemental Wave (Active):  Channel wild elemental magic to blast enemies in front of you with thunder, fire, ice, or poison.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字19: Force Globe (Active):  Blast all enemies in range with an explosion of wild magic.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字20: Berserk (Active):  Greatly increase attack power, but lose some defense.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字21: Sprint (Active):  Increase your movement speed for a short time.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字22: Life Force (Active):  Gain temporary HP & SP, and a chance to revive from death one time.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字23: Dash (Active):   When wielding two weapons, summon a powerful force that prevents all damage and propels you forward at great speed.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字24: Backstab I (Active):  Instantly move behind an enemy and attack it one time.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字25: Backstab II (Active):  Instantly move behind an enemy and attack it three times.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字26: Backstab III (Active):  Instantly move behind an enemy and attack it six times.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字27: Guardian (Active):  Summon a elemental Guardian to protect you from harm.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字28: Divine Blessing (Active):  All your attacks deal maximum damage for a short time.  Deal increased damage to enemy armor.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字29: Fire Elemental (Active):  Summon a Fire Elemental to hover around you and damage all enemies in range.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字30: Deflection (Active):  When actively defending with a shield, enemy damage to HP is absorbed by your SP instead.  If you actively defend just before the enemy attack hits, you recover some HP and SP, and can deal damage to enemy armor.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字31: Shield Bash I (Active):  Strike enemies with your shield, crushing their armor and knocking them back.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字32: Shield Bash II (Active):  Strike enemies heavily two times with your shield, crushing their armor and knocking them back.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字33: Set Skill:  You must equip an entire set of linked items to control their hidden power.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字34: Summon Storm (Active):  Summon a storm elemental.  It obeys your commands, attacking all the enemies in its path.  Use the mouse to control its movement.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字35: Meteor Storm (Active):  Call upon ancient forces to rain meteors upon enemies in target area.  Those who attempt to escape judgement will be severely punished.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字36: Charge Slash I (Passive):  Hold down the attack key to gather strength for a fierce attack.  Once the charge halo appears, release the attack button to perform a powerful attack that deals heavy damage to an enemy's health and armor.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字37: Charge Slash II (Passive):  Hold down the attack key longer to gather even greater strength for a deadly attack.  Once the charge halo appears, release the attack button to perform an extremely powerful attack that deals heavy damage to an enemy's health and armor.
xmlDataSkill.技能文字38: Assassin (Passive):  Deal amplified damage to enemies when attacking them from behind.

xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字39: Last Stand (Passive):  There is a chance that lethal damage will reduce your HP to 1 instead of killing you.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字40: Tiger Jump (Passive):  Avoid all damage when starting a jump.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字41: Protection from Evil (Passive):  Enhanced resistance to cursing magic.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字42: Dual Wield (Passive):  Wield two weapons with ease.  Gain great attack speed, but lose some attack power and defensive capability.  Higher skill levels amplify damage.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字43: Cross Slash (Passive):   When wielding two falchions, you can strike with both blades at the same time, dealing enhanced damage.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字44: Master of Defense(Passive):  While equipped with a shield, you can recover HP from each successful active defense.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字45: Damage Reflection (Passive):  There is a chance that some of the damage dealt to you is also dealt to the attacker.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字46: Frozen Shards I (Set Skill):  Strike nearby enemies with shards of ice.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字47: Frozen Shards II (Set Skill):  Attack all nearby enemies with two rows of ice shards.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字48: Ring of Fire I (Set Skill):  Conjure a ring of fire to burn all enemies in range.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字49: Ring of Fire II (Set Skill):  Generate two rings of fire to burn all enemies in range.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字50: Flame Spirit I (Set Skill):  Strike an enemy with a fireball that explodes and shoots out three more fireballs.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字51: Flame Spirit II (Set Skill):  Strike an enemy with a fireball that explodes and shoots out six more fireballs.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字52: Chain Lightning I (Set Skill):  Deal damage to a series of enemies as the lightning jumps between targets in range.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字53: Chain Lightning II (Set Skill):  Deal heavy damage to a series of enemies as the lightning jumps several times between targets in range.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字54: Plague (Set Skill):  Infect an enemy with poison damage that spreads to other enemies that come near it.
xmlDataSkill_1.技能文字55: Toxin (Set Skill) :  Conjure three orbs of acidic venom to poison enemies in range.

equipmentSets.name: Many ambitious warriors have searched the world for the fabled Blazing Set.  Once united, the fire-enchanted helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and weapon give the user an affinity for fire, and the ability to summon flames to burn enemies.  The wearer of the Blazing Set deals more damage in combat, and has an increased chance to score critical hits. (Extra attrib.: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 fire attribute, Lv3 attack bonus. Set skill: Fissure I)

The Swamp Witch's failed golem experiments gave rise to items which seem strangely alive.  Those who wear the envenomed helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and weapon can summon a Plague to weaken their enemies.  The wearer can also dissolve worthless materials left behind by fallen foes to reveal magical treasures more often, recover from injuries more rapidly, and has affinity for poison.
Set C

A secret society of vampires constructed life-draining armor for their battle thralls.  Those who wear the vampires' helmet, armor, gloves, and boots find that they heal quickly, and absorb life energies from slain foes. (Extra attrib: Lv4 HP recovery, Lv4 HP gained after an enemy was killed)

Legends tell of an ancient underground kingdom powered by mysterious magic crystals.  Explorers have discovered crystal-embedded artifacts created by this forgotten culture.  Those who wear the crystal helmet, armor, gloves, and boots will discover that they possess inexhaustible magic power. (Extra attribt:  Lv4 SP bonus, Lv4 SP recovery)

Frost Dragons cast magical traps on portions of their treasure hoards to catch thieves.  An enterprising alchemist discovered that he could transform these magical traps into useful items.  A human who wears the frost-enchanted helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and weapon gains an affinity for cold and the ability to attack foes with ice magic.  Skilled warriors can use the elemental power of ice to deal critical hits against enemies and deal greater damage in combat. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 ice attribute, Lv3 additional attack. Set skill:Cracking Ice I)

Thor himself is said to have created arms and armor to help mortals defend themselves against giants.  A worthy hero wielding one of Thor's weapons and wearing the lightning-enchanted helmet, armor, gloves, and boots can shoot lightning bolts at enemies.  Those who possess the Lightning Set are likely to score critical hits in combat and attack with greater ferocity and speed. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 thunder attribute, Lv3 additional attack. Set skill: Chain Lightning I)

Zealous warriors of the northern tribes once threw themselves into battle, howling with bloodlust as they slew invading armies.  One by one, these ferocious warriors fell, but their spirits melded with their weapons and armor.  Anyone who wields a Zealot's twin weapons while wearing their helmet, armor, gloves, and boots will find that they are able to endure deep wounds, deal great damage in combat, and blast their enemies with magic. (Extra attrib: Lv4 additional attack, Lv4 additional HP. Set skill: Fissure II)

It is said that divine beings gave humans powerful weapons and armor to defend against evil.  When united, these gifts could call down lightning to repel Titans.  Many of the heroes in the ancient tales possessed these powerful weapons.  To wield a Hero's weapon while wearing their helmet, armor, gloves, and boots is to come in contact with that mysterious ancient force.  The wearer will deal greater damage in combat and take less damage from enemies.  They will also gain greater magic power and toughness. (Extra attrib: Lv4 additional attack, Lv4 additional defense, Lv3 additional HP, Lv3 additional SP. Set skill: Chain Lightning II)

A group of wizards and witches formed an organization known as The Guardians to protect people from the evil sorcerer Mordeki and his army of cruel Death Knights.  They crafted magic helmets, armor, gloves, boots, and shields reinforced with defensive spells that protected them from both physical and magical attack. (Extra attrib: Lv4 additional defense, Lv4 magic resist)

Spider Clan Assassins were feared for their stealth, silence, and deadliness.  Their most elite agents earned a set of dual weapons, a helmet, armor, gloves, and boots that enabled them to easily score critical hits and poison enemies in combat.  The wearer also gained greater health and magic power, and the ability to cast poison spells at foes. (Extra attrib: Lv4 critical hit, Lv4 poison attribute, Lv2 additional HP, Lv2 additional SP. Set skill: Poison II)

The Lord of Shadow once ruled the surface world.  Few dared to speak his name.  To those who served him, he granted twin weapons and a special set of armor.  Anyone wearing the Shadow Lord's helmet, armor, gloves, and boots while wielding his dual weapons surged with great health and magic power, could command ice magic, and deal heavy critical hit damage in combat. (Extra attrib: Lv4 critical hit, Lv4 additional attack, Lv3 additional HP, Lv4 additional SP. Set skill: Cracking Ice II)

It was recently discovered that the legendary dwarven explorer known as "Lucky Rob" owed his good fortune to an unusual set of items.  Anyone wearing Lucky Rob's helmet, armor, gloves, and boots while wielding his weapon will discover that they have an uncanny instinct for finding treasure.  Interestingly, the items seem to sense when the wearer is in danger and can guide a combatant to strike at an enemy's weak spot. (Extra attrib: Lv4 critical hit, Lv3 critical hit, Lv4 drop rate)

Kang was a famous sword master who dazzled his opponents with his speed, skill, and explosive power.  The Master's twin weapons, helmet, armor, gloves, and boots are exceptionally light-weight and strong.  A skilled fighter wearing the Master's gear can deal greater damage in combat, score critical hits more often, and gains the ability to cast fire magic that splits into three additional fireballs on impact. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv4 additional attack. Set skill: Split Fire I)

The Southern Warlords discovered that certain combinations of looted artifacts could be bound together to grant them greater power.  Their sages performed rituals to bind a fire elemental into their Lord's weaponry.  Such a weapon linked to a magical helmet, armor, gloves, boots, and shield grant their user greater attack strength, increased health and magic power, and an affinity for fire magic.  Wearers of this set can cast a fireball that strikes up to six additional targets. (Extra attrib: Lv4 fire attribute, Lv4 additional attack, Lv3 additional HP, Lv3 additional SP. Set skill: Split Fire II)

A group of villagers assembled their ancestral artifacts to supply the hero Linok with armor as he prepared to battle the demon Gomon.  They were amazed to see that once united, the separate treasures pulsed with power.  The helmet, armor, gloves, and boots increase their wearer's attack strength and critical hit chance in combat.  The user also gains more health and magic power, and has a greater chance to find items of value. (Extra attrib: Lv2 critical hit, Lv2 additional attack, Lv2 additional HP, Lv2 additional SP, Lv2 additional drop rate)
